text: Kwalomu ka 11:29, ku kombisa ku vilela ku suke eWhitehall, ku hundza eTrafalgar Square, ku lulamana na Strand, ku hundza Aldwych ni ku tlhandluka na Kingsway ku kongoma eka Holborn laha Conservative Xiphemu a wu kekaya Spring Forum ehoteleni ya Grand Connaught Rooms.

text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Van’wana va tshemba, ku katsa na John Grant, leswaku ku hela ka minyikelo ni ku cinca eka minongonoko ya thelevhixini ya ku dyondzisa filosofi ku hoxe xandla eka ku hela ka ntlhandlamano wa xitori.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Bubutsa, lexi nga emphukeni wa 645 wa timayili (1040 km) hi le vupeladyambu bya swihlala swa Cape Verde, xi languteriwa ku hunguta xi nga si hlasela tindhawu leti ku tshamaka vanhu, hi ku vula ka vavhumbi.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred sweswi yi ni moya lowu fambaka hi rivilo ra 105 wa timayili hi awara (165 km/h) naswona yi kongome en’walungu vupeladyambu.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred i bubutsa ra matimba swinene leri tshamaka ri rhekhodiwa ku fikela sweswi edzongeni ni le vuxeni eAtlantic ku sukela hikuya hi ku sunguriwa swifaniso swa satelayiti, naswona i bubutsa ra vunharhu hi vukulu leri rhekhodiweke evuxeni ra 35°W.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Hi Ndzhati 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness u sayine kontiraka yo hirha ya malembe ya 9,000 ya St James' Gate Brewery le Dublin, Ireland.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Eka malembe ya 250 lama landzeleke, Guinness yi kula yi va bindzu ra misava hinkwayo ra tibiliyoni ku tlula 10 ta tiyuro (US$14.7 wa tibiliyoni) lembe ni lembe.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, muchayerikulobye wa ntlawa wa A1GP wa le New Zealand, namuntlha u endle matimu hi ku chayela ximfumo hi rivilo ra le henhla eka Auckland Harbour Bridge leri nga ni malembe ya 48, le New Zealand.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Nkul Reid u swi kotile ku chayela movha wa le New Zealand wa A1GP, Black Beauty hi rivilo ro tlula 160km/h minkarhi ya nkombo ehenhla ka buloho.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Maphorisa ya le New Zealand ma karhatekile ku tirhisa swibalesa swa swona swa rivilo ko pima rivilo ra Nkul Reid hikwalaho ka leswi Black Beauty a yi fambela ehansi, nkarhi wun’we ntsena laha maphorisa ma swi kotile ku pima rivilo ra Nkul Reid loko a hunguta rivilo ri fika eka 160km/h.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Eka tin’hweti ti-3, vabohiwa vo tlula 80 va ntshunxiwile eka xivandla xa Central Booking handle ko hehliwa ximfumo.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Hi Dzivamusoko lembe leri, ku humesiwe xileriso xa nkarhinyana xa ndziriso hi Muavanyisi Glynn eka xivandla lexi ku sindzisa ku ntshunxiwa ka lava khomiweke ku tlula tiawara ta 24 tiawara endzhaku ka ku khomiwa ka vona laha ku nga amukeriwangiki ntshamo wa khoto.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Mukhotsi u veke beyili, loko yi nyikiwa, ivi a endla swihehlo swi va ximfumo hi ku khotsa mutirhela mfumo. Kutani swihehlo swi nghenisiwa eka fambiselo ra khompyutara ya mfumo laha nandzu wu landzerisisiwaka kona.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Ntshamo wu tlhela wu fungha siku ra mfanelo ya muehleketeleriwa ro sengisiwa hi xihatla.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, muhlayisi wa timali wa le Australia ni loyi swi tikombaka a ta teka xikhundlha xa Holobyenkulu John Howard tanihi murhangeri wa vandla ra Liberal u seketele vumaki bya matimba ya nyutliya le Australia.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Nkul Costello u vule leswaku loko ku humesiwa ka matimba ya nyutliya ku tirha kahle hi tlhelo ikhonomi, Australia ri fanele ku sungula ku ma tirhisa.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Loko ma sungula ku xavisiwa, hi fanele hi va na wona. Hileswaku, ku hava nkaneto wo karhi wa matimba ya nyutliya" ku vule Nkul Costello.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Vativi va nawu lava dumeke va Magiriki, Sakis Kechagioglou na George Nikolakopoulos va khotsiwile le jele ra Athens ra Korydallus, tanihi leswi va voniweke nandzu wa vugevenga na vukungundzwana.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Ku tlula kwalaho, Muavanyisi la tlakukeke ku nga Evangelos Kalousis u khotsiwile tanihi leswi a voniwe nandzu wa vukungundzwana na ku tsana ka matikekayale.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts u kanerile hi ku helele ku vula loko a pfumela leswaku vutomi byi ni masungulo, ku nga xivutiso xa nkoka loko ku ehlekeriwa hi timahak ta xixa khwiri, a vula leswaku a swi amukeleki ku vulavula hi ku kongoma hi swilo leswi nga tshukaka swi endleka.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Hambiswiritano, yena, u kandziyisile eka marito yakwe leswaku Roe v. Wade a ku ri "nawu lowu tiyeke wa ta misava ", a kandziyisa nkoka wa vuavanyisi bya le Khotokulu lebyi fambelanaka.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Nakambe u tiyisisa leswaku u pfumela eka mfanelo yo va ni xihundla leyi xiboho xa Roe a xi titshege ha yona.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae i muxaka wa xivumbiwa xa ntlawa wa Dromaeosauridae naswona i xaka ra Velociraptor.
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: N’wala wa yona wa vumbirhi a wu kurile, leswi vangeke leswaku yi thyiwa Hesperonychus leswi vulaka "n’wala wa le vupeladyambu."
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Tinhlamuselo, leti endliwaka thwii eka thelevhixini, a ku ri ro sungula laha swihlovo swa mahungu swa le Iran swi pfumeleke leswaku ku yirisiwa ku ni nkucetelo.
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Swi katsa misivelo ya timali hi European Union eku rhumeriweni ka oyilimbili eka matikomambe, laha ikhonomi ya Iran yi amukelaka 80% ya mali ya yona yo huma eka matiko man’wana.
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Murhangerikulu wa tiko, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, u hlamusele ku tirhisiwa ngopfu ka oyili tanihi "ntlhamu" ku sukela emahlweni ka hundzuluko wa Vuislamu bya Iran hi 1979 naswona tiko ri fanele ku titshunxa eka swona.
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Loko xitirhisiwa xi fike emisaveni ivi xi nghena eka atimosifiya, kwalomu ka 5 (nkarhi wa le vuxeni), ku languteriwe leswaku ku va ni nkombiso wutsongo eka vanhu va le N’walungwini wa California, le Oregon, Nevada, na Utah.
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Xitirhisiwa lexi xi ta languteka tanihi nyeleti leyi bulukaka yi tsemakanya lwangu ra tilo.
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: Xitirhisiwa xi ta famba hi rivilo ra kwalomu ka 12.8 km kumbe 8 wa timayili hi sekoni, rivilo leri ringaneke ku suka eSan Francisco ku ya le Los Angeles hi minete yin’we.
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Stardust yi ta veka rhekhodo leyintshwa ya misava hi ku va xibamubamu lexintshwa xa nkarhi hinkwawo lexi nga ta tlhelela eMisaveni, xi tlula rhekhodo ya nkarhi lowu hundzeke leyi endliweke hi May wa 1969 hi nkarhi wa ku tlhela ka Apollo X command module.
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: “Xi ta suka eribuweni ra le vupeladyambu bya n’walungu wa California naswona xi ta voninga tilo ku suka eCalifornia kuya fika exikarhi ka Oregon na kuya fika le Nevada na Idaho na Utah,” hi ku vula ka Tom Duxbury, manenjara wa tsima ra Stardust.
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Xiboho xa Nkul. Rudd xo sayina xiboho xa ntwanano wa Kyoto xi vekela etlhelo United States, laha sweswi ku nga ta va rona ntsena tiko leri hluvukeke leri nga amukelangiki ntwanano lowu.
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: Hulumendhe ya khale ya le Australia yi arile ku amukela Kyoto, ku vuriwe leswaku ntwanano wolowo a wu ta onha ikhonomi tanihi leswi yi titshegeke swinene hi ku rhumela malahla eka matikomambe, kasi matiko yo fana na India na China a ma nga bohiwi hi tipakani ta pfhumba rero.
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: Ku xaviwa ka khampani leyi hi lokukulu ematin’wini ya eBay.
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: N’weti wa Enceladus i xivumbeko lexi vangamaka swinene eka ndyangu wa dyambu, wu humesa ku vonakala ka kwalomu ka 90 wa tiphesente loku yaka eka wona.
text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text_en: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: Ntlango lowu wu sekeriwe eka Nyimpi ya Vumbirhi ya Fallujah, ku nga nyimpi ya madzolonga exikarhi ka masocha ya Maamerika ni ya Iraqi.
text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: ACMA yi tlhele yi kuma leswaku ku nga khathariseki leswi vhidiyo yi haxiweke eka Inthanete, Big Brother a nga yi tshovanga milawu yo kambela rungula ra le ka Inthanete tanihi leswi vuhaxi byebyo a byi nga hlayisiwanga eka webusayiti ya Big Brother.
text_en: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text_en: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text_en: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: Ku sukela loko yi sunguriwile, The Onion yi hundzuke nhlangano lowukulu lowu encenyetaka mahungu, yi ni nkandziyiso lowu printiwaka, yi ni webusayiti leyi kokeke rinoko ra vanhu va 5,000,000 hi n’hweti ya October, leyi vanhu va navetisaka eka yona, yi ni xitichi xa mahungu lexi tlangaka tiawara ta 24, yi ni tipodcasts ni atlas ya misava leyi ya ha ku humesiwaka leyi vuriwaka Our Dumb World.
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: Al Gore na Jenerala Tommy Franks va pfa va humelela katsongo eka tinhlokomhaka ta mahungu ta vona leti tsakisaka (The Onion yi vike hi Gore loko yena na Tipper va vule leswaku va tiphine swinene hi masangu endzhaku ka loko a hluriwe eka Nhlawulo wa le Kholechi hi 2000).
text_en: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: Vatsari va vona vo tala va hetelele va va ni nkucetelo lowukulu eka nongonoko wa mahungu wa mafenya wa Jon Stewart ni wa Stephen Colbert.
text_en: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text_en: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.

text_en: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.

text_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.

text_en: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.

text_en: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.

text_en: The Northern Rock bank had been nationalised in 2008 following the revelation that the company had received emergency support from the UK Government.

text_en: In 2010, while nationalised, the current high street bank Northern Rock plc was split from the ‘bad bank’, Northern Rock (Asset Management).

text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Vanhu a va tshova ma fasitere hi switshamo, kambe a swi nga tshoveki.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: “Emahetelelweni, fasitere rin'wana ri tshovekile, naswona vanhu va sungule ku huma hi rona,” u vule tano Franciszek Kowal loyi a poneke.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Tinyeleti ti humesa rivoningo na ku hisa hikwalaho ka matimba lama endliwaka loko tiathomu ta hayidirojeni ti hlanganisiwa (kumbe ti endliwa xilo xin’we) leswaku ti endla ti elemente to tika.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Va n’wasayense va le ku tirheni leswaku va endla xitirhisiwa lexi nga ta humesa matimba hi laha ku fanaka.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Leswi, hambiswiritano, i xiphiqo xo tika swinene ku kuma xintshuxo xa xona naswona swi ta teka malembe wo tala ku nga si endliwa switirhisiwa leswi.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Nayiti ya nsimbi ya phaphamala ehenhla ka mati hi hikwalaho ka matimba yo khomelela.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Matimba yo khomelela ya endleka hikuva timolekhuli ta mati ehenhla ka mati ti khomanile swinene ku tlula ndlela leyi ti khomaneke ha yona ni timolekhuli ta moya leti nga ehenhla ka tona.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Timolekhuli ta mati ti endla xikhumba lexi nga vonakiki enhla ka mati lexi pfumelelaka swilo swo fana na nayiti leswaku swi phaphamala ehenhla ka mati.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Nsimbi leyi nga kona eka xilo xa ku tswiririka eayisini xa masiku lama ku ni matlhelo mambirhi lama govekeke laha ma hlanganaka kona. Matlhelo lamambirhi ya xi nyika mpfumelelo wo khoma ayisi, ni loko xi voyamile.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Hikuva ehansi ka nsimbi ku petsiwe kahle, loko nsimbi yi voyamela etlhelo rin’wana, tlhelo leri khumbaneke ni ayisi na rona ra voyama.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Leswi swi endla leswaku munhu la fambaka hi xona a jika. Loko xilo xo tswiririka eayisini xi voyamela exineneni, munhu loyi a fambaka hi xona na yena u jikela exineneni, loko xilo xo tswiririka e ayisini xi jikela eximatsini, munhu la fambaka hi xona u jikela eximatsini.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Leswaku ti tlhelela eka ntsengo wa matimba lama a ti ri na wona, ti fanele ti susa matimba lama engetelekeke lama ti ma kumeke eka rivoningo.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Ti endla leswi hi ku humesa xiphakitani xitsongo xa rivoningo lexi vuriwaka “fothoni”
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Va n’wasayense va vita fambiselo leri nge “mahumeselo ya nyawuso lama endliweke” hikuva tiathomu ti endliwa hi rivoni leri vangamaka, leri ri endlaka leswaku yi humesa fothoni ya rivoni, naswona rivoni hi muxaka wa nyawuso.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Xifaniso lexi landzelaka xikombisa tiathomu leti humesaka tifothoni. Entiyisweni, tifothoni ta ntiyiso i titsongo ngopfu loko ti pimanisiwa ni leti ti nga le xifanisweni.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Tifothoni i titsongo eka swilo leswi endlaka tiathomu!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Endzhaku ka madzana ya tiawara filamenti leyi nga le ndzeni ka rivoni yi karhi yi tirha, endzhaku ka nkarhi ya tshwa naswona rivoni ri tshika ku tirha.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Endzhaku ka sweswo, rivoni ri lava ku cinciwa. I swa nkoka ngopfu leswaku u tivonela loko u cinca rivoni.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Xo sungula, swichi ya rivoni yi fanele yi timiwa kumbe ntambhu yi susiwa.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Leswi swi endliwa hikuva gezi leri fambaka eka sokhete laha xiphemu xa rivoni xa nsimbi xi tshamaka kona xi nga ku chowuka ngopfu loko u khoma le ndzeni ya sokhete kumbe ndhawu ya nsimbi eka rivoni loko xiphemu xa yona xi ri karhi xi ri endzeni.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Xirho lexikulu xa mafambiselo ya ngati lama rhendzelekaka yi mbilu, leyi yi pompaka ngati.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Ngati yi suka embilwini hi tiphayiphi leti vitaniwaka tiatheri naswona yi tlhelela embilwini hi ti phayiphi leti vitaniwaka tivheyini. Tiphayiphi letitsongo ti vitaniwa tikhaphilari.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Meno ya ti triceratops a ta swi kota ku pfotlosa ku nga ri ntsena matluka kambe ni marhavi ni timitsu leti tiyeke ngopfu.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Van’wana va vativi va sayense va ehleketa leswaku ti Triceratops a ti dya swimila swa ncindzu, leswi nga muxaka wa ximilla lowu a wu tolovelekile enkarhirini wa Cretaceous.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Swimila leswi swi fana na murhi wa ncindzu lowutsongo lowu nga ni harhi ya matluka lama tlhavaka, ni lama nga tsontswa.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratops a yi ta va yi tirhisa nomu wa yona lowu nga tiya ku susa matluka yi nga si dya nsinya.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Vativi va sayense van’wana va vula leswaku swimila leswi swi na chefu ngopfu hikwalaho a swi tshembisi leswaku dinasoro yihi ni yihi yi nga va yi swi dyile, hambiloko namuntlha sloth ni swiharhi swinwana ku fana na hokwe (ku nga ntukulu wa tidinasoro) swi nga dya matluka kumbe mbhandzu lowu nga ni chefu.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Xana nkoka-misava wa lo u nga ndzi koka njhani? Loko u yima ehenhla ka vuandlalo bya lo, a wu ta tika ku nga tluli ndlela leyi u tikaka ha yona loko u ri Emisaveni.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Munhu la nga ni ntiko wa tiphawundi ta 200 (90kg) loko a ri emisaveni, ntiko wa yena u ta va tiphawundi ta 36 (16kg) loko a ri eka lo. Kutani nkoka-misava, hakunene, u nge ku koke ngopfu.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Dyambu a ri na vukoko ku fana ni Misava laha u nga yimaka ehenhla ka kona. Dyambu hinkwaro ri endliwe yi tigasi, ndzilo na plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gasi yi va yo lala loko u ya kule na xikarhi xa dyambu.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Xiphemu xa le handle lexi hi xi vonaka loko hi languta dyambu xi vitaniwa photosphere, leyi vulaka “bolo ya rivoningo”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Kwalomu ka malembe ya magidi manharhu, hi 1610, Galileo Galilei, mutivi wa tinyeleti wa Muntariyana u tirhise theleskopu ku vona leswaku Venus yi na swiyenge, tanihi leswi n’weti yi ri na swona.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Swiyenge swi humelela hikuva i tlhelo ra Venus ntsena (kumbe ra n’weti) leri languteke Dyambu leri kumaka rivoningo. Swiyenge swa Venus a swi seketela dyondzo ya Copernicus ya leswaku tipulanete ti rhendzeleka Dyambu.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Kutani, endzhaku ka malembenyana hi 1639, mutivi wa tinyeleti wa Munghezi, Jeremiah Horrocks u vone ku suka ka Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Nghilandhi ri ve ni nkarhi wo leha wa ku rhula endzhaku ka ku hlula ravumbirhi ku tirhisiwa ka nawu wa le Denmark.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Hambiswiritano hi 991 Ethelred u langutane ni nxaxamelo wa swikepe wa maViking lowu a wu ri wukulu ku tlula wihi ni wihi ku sukela wa Guthrum eka malembexidzana ya le mahlweni.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Nxaxamelo lowu wa swikepe a wu rhangeriwe hi Olaf Trygvasson, muNorway loyi a lava ku tlhela a teka tiko rakwe eka vulawuri bya Denmark.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Endzhaku ka ku hluleka ko rhanga ka nyimpi, Ethelred u kote ku pfumelelana swinawana na Olaf, loyi a tlheleleke eNorway ku ya ringeta ku kuma mfumo wakwe laha a humeleleke hi ndlela yo karhi.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul i yona ntsena letere leyi nga endliwa hi xikongomelo eku tirhisiweni siku ni siku loku tolovelekeke. Letere leyi yi endliwe hi 1444 enkarhini wa ku fuma ka Hosi Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Hosi Sejong a ku ri hosi ya vumune eka Ntlhandlamano wa Tihosi wa Joseon naswona i un’we wa lava tekiwaka va ri va nkoka.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Eku sunguleni u thye letere ra Hangeul vito leri nge Hunmin Jeongeum, leri vulaka “mpfumawulo lowu kongomeke leswaku ku lerisiwa vanhu”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Ku na tidyondzo to tala ta leswaku Xisanskrit xi ve ke kona. Yin’wana yi vulavula hi ku rhurha ka Vaaryan ku suka vupela-dyambu ku nghena eka Indiya lava nga ta ni ririmi ra vona.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Xisanskrit i ririmi ra khale naswona ri nga fanisiwa ni ririmi ra Xilatini leri vulavuriwaka eYuropa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Buku yo sungula leyi tiviwaka emisaveni a yi tsariwe hi Xisanskrit. Endzhaku ka ku hlengeletiwa ka Vaupanishad, Xisanskrit xo pfa xi nyamalala hikwalaho ka ntlawa wa valawuri.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Xisanskrit i ririmi leri rharhanganeke ni leri fuweke, leri nga tirhisiwa tanihi xihlovo xa tindzimi to tala ta manguva lawa, ku fana ni loko Xilatini ku ri xihlovo xa tindzimi ta le Yuropa ta ku fana ni Xifurwa ni Xipaniya.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Loko nyimpi ya ku lwela Furwa yi hela, Jarimani yi sungule ku ti lunghiselela ku hlasela xihlala xa Britain.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Jarimani yi thye nhlaselo lowu yi vito ra khodi leri nge “Vutirheli bya Sealion”. Matlhari yo tala ya Mavuthu ya Britain xikan’we ni mphakelo wa vona u lahlekile loko va rhurha eDunkirk, hikwalaho vuthu a ri tsanile.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Kambe Vuthu ra le Matini ra le Vuhosini hambiswiritano a ri ni matimba ku tlula Vuthu ra le Matini ra Jarimani (“Kriegsmarine”) naswona a ri nga swi kota ku herisa ku hlaseriwa kun’wana ni kun’wana loku nga rhumeriwa hi Mugerho wa le Nghilandhi.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Hambiswiritano, i swikepe swo hlayanyana swa Vuthu ra le Matini ra le Vuhosini leswi nga vekiwa etindleleni laha ku nga hlaseriwa kona hikwalaho ka valawuri va vuthu ra le matini lava a va chava leswaku va ta herisiwa hi nhlaselo wa le moyeni wa Majarimani.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: A hi sunguleni hi ku hlamusela makungu ya Italiya. Italiya ngopfu-ngopfu a yi ri “ndzisana” ya Jarimani ni Japani.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: A yi ri ni vuthu ro tsana ni vuthu ra le matini ro tsana, hambiloko a va ake swikepe swa mune leswintshwa ku nga si sungula nyimpi.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Xikongomelo lexikulu xa Italiya a ku ri matiko ya le Afrika. Ku teka matiko wolawo, a va ta lava ndhawu ya ku humesa mavuthu, leswaku mavuthu a kota ku tluta a tsemakanye Lwandle ra Mediteraniya ni ku hlasela Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Hikwalaho ka sweswo, va boheke ku susa tintsindza ta masocha ya le Britain ni swikepe leswi nga aEgipta. Handle ka swiendlo sweswo, swikepe swa nyimpi swa Italiya a swi nga fanelanga ku endla nchumo wun’wana.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Sweswi hi ta eka Japani. Japani a ku ri tiko ra xihlala, ku fana ni Britain.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Swikepe swa le hansi ka mati i swikepe leswi nga endleriwa ku famba ehansi ka mati, naswona swi tshame kwalaho hi nkarhi wo leha.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Swikepe swa le hansi ka mati a swi tirhisiwa hi Nyimpi yo Sungula ya Misava ni hi Nyimpi ya Vumbirhi ya Misava.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Loko nyimpi yi sungula hi xitalo a swi famba ehenhla ka lwandle, kambe loko radar yi sungula ku hluvuka naswona yi kongoma ngopfu swikepe swa le hansi ka mati swi boheke ku nghena ehansi ka mati ku papalata ku voniwa.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Swikepe swa le hansi ka mati swa Majarimani a swi vitaniwa U-Boats. Majarimani a va swi kota kahle ku tluta ni ku fambisa swikepe swa vona swa le hansi ka mati.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Hikwalaho ka ku humelela ka vona hi swikepe swa le hansi ka mati, endzhaku ka nyimpi Majarimani a ma tshembiwi leswaku ma va na swona swo tala.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ina! Hosi Tutankhamun, loyi nkarhi un’wana a vitaniwaka “Hosi Tut” kumbe “Hosi Ya Mufana”, i yin’wana ya tihosi ta le Egipta ya khale leti tiviwaka swinene hi manguva lawa.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Lexi hlamarisaka, a nga tekiwi a ri wa nkoka ngopfu eminkarhini ya khale kambe a nga rekhodiwanga e ka minxaxamelo yo tala ya khale ya tihosi.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Hambiswiritano, ku kumiwa ka sirha ra yena hi 1992 ku n’wi endle munhu loyi a dumeke. Hambiloko va teke swilo emasirheni yo tala ya khale, sirha leri ri tshikiwi ri nga kavanyetiwanga.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Swilo swo tala le swi nga lahliwa swin’we na Tutankhamun swi hlayiseke kahle, ku hlanganisa na magidi ya ntivo-vuxongi leswi nga endliwa hi mintsopfu ya risima na maribye yo kala.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Ku endliwa ka mavhilwa ya swinsimbana ku endle makalichi ya nyimpi ya Vaasiriya mavevuka, ma va ni rivilo, naswona ma lunghekela ku siya masocha na makalichi man’wana.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Miseve leyi humaka e ka mavhura la ma dlayaka a yi swi kota ku nghena eka mahavelo ya masocha lama va lwaka na wona. Kwalomu ka 1000 B.C., Vaasiriya va sungule ku lwa hi vagadi va tihanci vo sungula.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Vagadi va tihanci i vuthu leri lwaka ri khandziye tihanci. Switshamo leswi tlhandlekiwaka ehancini a swi nga si tirhisiwa, hikwalaho vagadi va tihanci va va Asiriya a va lwa va tshame ehenhla ka nhlana wa hanci u nga ri na nchumu.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Hi tiva va n’watipolitiki vo tala va Magriki, van’wasayense, na vampfampfarhuti vo tala. Swi nga endleka leswaku munhu loyi a tiviwaka ngopfu eka ndhavuko lowu i Homer, mutlhokovetseri loyi a feke mahlo loyi a tiviwaka ngopfu, loyi a tsaleke tibuku timbirhi ta vutshila ta Xigriki, swiphato swa Iliad na Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles ni Aristophanes ku ha ri vatsari va mintlangu lava tiviwaka ngopfu nakambe va tekiwa ku ri van’wana va vatsari lava nga emahlweni emisaveni.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Mugriki un’wana loyi a dumeke i mutivi wa tinhlayo Pythagoras, loyi a tiviwaka ngopfu hi nhlamuselo ya yena leyi dumeke ya kutirhisana ka matlhelo ya swivunguvungu swa tinhla tinharhu ta engele ya 90 wa tidigri.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ku ni ku ringanyetiwa loku hambaneke ka nhlayo ya vanhu lava vulavulaka Xihindi. Ku ringaniselwa leswaku xi le xikarhi ka ririmi leri vuriwaka ngopfu ra vumbirhi ni ra vumune emisaveni.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Nhlayo ya vavulavuri va kwalaho yi hambana ku titshege hi leswaku ku hlayiwa swindzimana leswi yelanaka swinene kumbe e-e.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Ku ringanyeta ku suka eka vavulavuri lava sukaka eka 340 ya timiliyoni ku ya eka 500 ya timiliyoni, nakambe kwalomu ka vanhu va 800 ya timiliyoni va kota ku twisisa ririmi leri.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Xihindi ni Xiurdu swa fana hi marito kambe swi hambane hi matsalelo; emabulweni ya siku ni siku, vavulavuri va tindzimi leti hi vumbirhi hi ntolovelo va swi kota ku twisisana.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Hi lembe xidzana ra vu 15, Estonia ya le n’walungu a yi ri ehansi ka nkucetelo wa ndhavuko lowukulu wa Jarimani.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Tinghwendza tin’wana ta Majarimani a ti lava ku tshineta Xikwembu eka vanhu va ndhawu yoleyo, hikwalaho va endle ririmi ra Estonia ro kongoma.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: A ri sekeriwe eka letere ra Xijarimani naswona letere rin’we ra "Õ/õ" ri engeteriwile.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Hi ku famba ka nkarhi, marito yo tala lama nga lombiwa eka Xijarimani a hlanganisiwile. Leswi a ku ri ku sungula ka ku voningela.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Hi ntolovelo, mudyandzhaka wa xiluvelo a ta ya evusocheni hi ku kongoma loko a hete xikolo.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Hambiswiritano, Charles u ye a yunivhesithi leyi nge Trinity College, eCambridge laha a dyondzeleke kona dyondzo ya Ndhavuko wa Vanhu ni Vuyimburi, kambe endzhaku ka sweswo dyondzo ya Matimu, a kuma 2:2 (digri ya ntlawa wa vumbhirhi wa le hansi)
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles a ku ri xirho xo sungula xa Ndyangu wa le Vuhosini le Britain xo nyikiwa digri.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turkey ya le Yuropa (Thrace ya le vuxeni kumbe Rumelia a nhlonhleni ya Balkan) yi katsa 3% ya tiko.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Ndhawu ya Turkey i hundza tikhilomitara ta 1,600 (1,000 miles) hi ku leha ni 800 km (500 mi) hi ku anama, hi xivumbeko xa bokisi.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Ndhawu ya Turkey, ku katsa mativa, yi endla swikwere-khilomitara swa 783,562 (300, 948 sq mi) leyi swikwere-khilomitara swa 755,688 (291,773 sq mi) swi nga le dzonga vupela-dyambu Asia ni swikwere-khilomitara swa 23,764 (9,174 sq mi) e Yuropa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Ndhawu ya Turkey yi yi endla tiko ra vu 37 lerikulu emisaveni, naswona yi ringana ni Doroba ra Furwa ni United Kingdom swi hlanganile.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Italiya yi rhendzeleriwe hi malwandle ematlhelweni manharhu: Lwandle ra Aegean ku ya evupela-dyambu, Lwandle ra Ntima ku ya n’walungwini ni Lwandle ra Mediteraniya ku ya edzongeni.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg yi na matimu yo leha kambe ku ti yimela ku sungule ku sukela hi 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Swiphemu swa Belgium ya namuntlha a ku ri xiphemu xa Luxembourg hi nkarhi lowu hundzeke kambe yi xiphemu xa Belgium endzhaku ka Nhlunga-vuhosi wa le Belgium was 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg a yi tshama yi ringeta ku tshama yi ri tiko leri nga ni vukala-tlhelo kambe yi hlaseriwe hi Jarimani hi Nyimpi yo Sungula ya Misava ni Nyimpi ya Vumbirhi ya Misava hi vumbirhi.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Hi 1957 Luxembourg yi ve xirho xo sungula xa nhlengeletano leyi namutlha yi tiviwaka tanihi European Union.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukygyal Dzong i khokholo leri nga onheka ni tindlu ta tinghwendza ta Mabudha eka xiphemo xa le henhla xa Muganga wa Paro (Eximutanini xa Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Ku vuriwa leswaku hi 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel u endle khokholo leri ku tsundzuka loko a hlula mavuthu ya Tibetan-Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Hi 1951, ndzilo wu vange leswaku swin’wana swa swilo leswi saleke swa Drukgyal Dzong swi tshama swi ri kona, ku fana ni xifaniso xa Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Endzhaku ka ku va na ndzilo, khokholo ri hlayisiwile ni ku sirheleriwa, ri tshama ku ri swin’wana swa leswi hlamarisaka leswi rhandziwaka ngopfu swa Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Hi lembe-xidzana ra vu-18 Cambodia yi ti kume yi manyane e xikarhi ka mifumo mimbirhi leyi nga ni matimba ya le kusuhi, Thailand ni Vietnam
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Vanbu va le Thaiwan va hlaseli Cambodia kotalanyana hi lembe xidzana ra vu-18 kambe hi 1772 va lovisi Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Emalembeni yo hetelela ya lembe-xidzana ra vu-18 vanhu va le Vietnam va hlasele Cambodia kambe.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Khume-nhungu wa tiphesente ta vanhu va le Venezuela a va tirhi, kambe vo tala lava tirhaka va tirha mintirho ya nkarhinyana.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Mbirhi-xa-nharhu wa vanhu va le Venezuela lava tirhaka wu tirha mintirho ya xisekelo, kwalomu ka kotara yi tirha a tifemeni kambe n’we-xa-vuntlhanu wu tirha eka vurimi.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Ntirho wa nkoka ka vanhu va le Venezuela i oyili, la tiko leri ri rhumelaka oyili ngopfu ematikweni mambe, hambiloko phesente yin’we ntsena yi tirhaka entirhweni wa oyili.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Eku sunguleni ka ku tiyimela ka tiko leri, vutshila bya Singapore Botanic Gardens byi pfune ku hundzula xihlala lexi xi va Doroba ra Ntanga ra le ndhawini yo hisa.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Hi 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, orchid leyi pfanganisiweke, yi hlawuriwile leswaku yi va xiluva xa tiko.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Lembe na lembe hi October kwalomu ka timiliyoni ta 1.5 leti dyaka swimilana swa famba swi kongoma timbala-ntshava ta le dzongeni, ti pela Nambu wa Mara ku suka a switsungeni swa le n’walungwini leswaku ti kuma mpfula.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Kutani ti tlhelela endzhaku a n’walungwini ku ya evupela-dyambu, ti tlhela ti pela Nambu wa Mara, endzhaku ka mpfula hi April.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Xifundzha xa Serengeti xi katsa ePhakeni ya Tiko ya Serengeti, Ndhawu leyi Sirheleriweke ya Ngorongoro ni Ntanga wa Swihari wa Maswa eTanzania ni Ntanga wa leswi nga Sirheleriwa eKenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Ku dyondza ku endla vuhaxi lebyi nga ni nkucetelo ku laveka vuswikoti lebyi tolovelekeke ni lebyi nga simekiwa khale, ku katsa ni switirho leswi nga dyondziwa ka titlilasi ta ku va ni nkucetelo (mpfampfarhuta wa swifaniso, ku lunghisa rungula leri rhekhodiweke ni vidiyo, ku vulavula xitori, ni swi’nwana.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Ku vumba loku nga ni nkucetelo ku lava leswaku u kambisisa nakambe mavonelo ya wena hi ku endla vuhaxi ni ku dyondza ku ehleketa hi tindlela leti nga riki to kongoma.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Ku vumba loku nga ni nkucetelo ku lava leswaku swiphemu swa ntirho swi nga fambisana, kambe ni leswaku swi twisiseke loko swi famba swi ri swin’we.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Xiphiqo xa tilense ta ku tshineta swilo i leswaku ku rharhangana ka langutelo ni nhlayo ya swiaki swa lense leswi lavekaka ku kuma ku leha ka langutelo i lokukulu ku tlula tilense ta ku leha ka langutelo leti simekiweke.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Leswi swi va nchumu wutsongo tanihi leswi vaendli va tilense va fikelela swiyimo swa le henhla swa ku endla tilense.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Leswi swi pfumele tilense ta ku tshineta swilo ku humesa swifaniso swa xiyimo xa le henhla loko swi ringanisiwa na tilensi ta ku leha ka langutelo loku nga simekiwa.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Xiphiqo xin’wana xa tilense ta ku tshineta swilo i mpimo lowukulu wa vukulu bya ximbhovana (i rivilo) xa lense byi le hansi.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Leswi swi endla leswaku ku tika ku tirhisa tilense ta ku tshineta swilo leti nga durhiki a ti ndhawini to kala rivoningo lerikulu handle ka rivoni ra miseve.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Xin’wana xa swiphiqo leswi tolovekeke loko u ringeta ku cincela muvhi eka fomati ya DVD i ku anamisa leswi voniwaka eka xikirini.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Tithelevhixini to tala ti endliwe hi ndlela yo tsakisa vanhu hinkwavo.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Hikokwalaho, hinkwaswo leswi u swi vonaka eka TV a swi tsemiwile eka mindzilakana, ehenhla, ehansi ni le matlhelweni.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Leswi swi endleriwa ku tiyisisa leswaku xifaniso xi tata xikirini hinkwaxo. Sweswo swi vuriwa ku anamisa leswi voniwaka eka xikirini.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Lexi twisaka ku vava, loko u endla DVD, mindzilakana ya kona na yona yi nga tshuka yi tsemiwa, kutani loko marito lama hlamuselaka leswi vuriwaka eka vhidiyo ya ri ekusuhi ni le hansi ka xikirini, a ma nge vonaki hi ku helela.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Xigodlo xa ndhavuko xa le ka malembexikarhi i khale xi hlohlotele mianakanyo leyintshwa, xi pfuxa swifaniso swa lava lwaka va khandziye tihanci, swakudya swa vanhu vo tala ni maendlelo ya xichavo xa hosi Arthur.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Hambiloko u yime emarhumbini lama nga ni gidi ra malembe a swi tiki ku tsundzuka mimpfumawulo ni minun’hwelo ya tinyimpi ta khale, ku twa onge ku twala ku ketlaketla ka mikondzo ya tihanci eswiribyanini ni ku twa nun’hwelo wa nchavo wu huma emigodini ya vubohiwa.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Kambe xana leswi hi swi anakanyaka swi sekeriwe eka leswi endlekeke? Hikokwalaho ka yini swigodlo swi akiwile kahlekahle? Swi endliwe njani naswona swi akiwe njani?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Lexi tolovelekeke enkarhini wolowo, Kirby Muxloe Castle i yindlu leyi nga sirheleriwa ku hundza ku va khokholo ra xiviri.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Mafisitere lamakulu lama nga funengetiwa ya rona ni makhumbi yo lala a nga ta swi kota ku sivela hi nkarhi wo leha nhlaselo lowu nga lunghiseleriwa.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Hi va 1480, loko ku akiwa ka yona ku sunguriwe hi Hosi Hastings, tiko a ri ri ni ku rhula kambe ku ti lwela a ku laveka ntsena eka mavutho lamatsongo ya vaphangi lava famba-fambaka.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Vulawuri lebyi pimiweke a ku ri ndlela leyi matiko ya Yuropa a a lava ku lawula vuhosi bya matiko hinkwawo ya Yuropa.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Mianakanyo a ku ri leswaku matiko ya Yuropa a a fanele ku sivela tiko rin’we leswaku ri nga vi ni matimba, kutani hindlela yoleyo tihulumendhe ta matiko a ti tshama ti ri karhi ti cinca vanakulobye leswaku ku va ni ku pimiwa.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Nyimpi ya Xikhundlha xa ku Fuma ya Spaniya a ku ri masungulo ya nyimpi yo sungula leyi mhaka leyikulu ya yona a ku ri vulawuri lebyi pimiweke.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Loku a ku ri ku cinca lokukulu, tanihi leswi mimfumo ya le Yuropa a yi nga ta tiendla onge yilwa tinyimpi ta vukhongeri. Hikwalaho, Nyimpi ya Malembe ya Makumenharhu a ku tava nyimpi yo hetelela leyi a yi ta vitaniwa hi leswaku i ya vukhongeri.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Tempele ya Artemis aEfesa yi lovisiwe hi July 21, 356 BCE hi ku hisiwa hi ndzilo hi Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Ku ya hi xitori lexi, nsusumeto wa yena a ku ri ku va ni ndhuma hi ndlela yihi na yihi. Vanhu va le Efesa, va hlundzukile, va tivise leswaku vito ra Herostratus ri nga rhekhodiwi.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: N’wamatimu wa Mugriki Strabo endzhaku ka nkarhi u tsale vito leri, ku nga rona leri hi ri tivaka namuntlha. Tempele yi lovisiwe hi vusiku vun’we lebyi Alekzanda Lonkulu a nga velekiwa hi byona.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alekzanda, tanihi hosi, u te u ta hakelela ku pfuxeta tempele, kambe a nga pfumeleriwanga. Endzhaku ka nkarhi, endzhaku ka loko a lovile, tempele yi pfuxetiwile hi 323 BCE.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Tiyiseka leswaku nhloko ya wena yi ntshunxekile hi laha swi kotekaka ha kona loko u ri karhi u chaya tinoto hinkwato hi ndlela leyi faneleke - kambe ringeta ku nga fambisi tintiho ta wena hi tindlela tin’wana
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Hi ndlela leyi, u ta endla leswaku u nga karhali hi laha swi kotekaka hakona. Tsundzuka leswaku a xi kona xivangelo xo chaya hi matimba la makulu leswaku ku va ni mpfumawulo lowu engeteleke ku fana ni le ka piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Ka kositina, leswaku u kuma mpfumawulo wo engeteleka, u tirhisa xihuhuti hi ku engetela ntshikelelo ni rivilo.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Dyondzo ya ku va swin’we ni Xikwembu i ku lava ku va ni ntwanano, ku tiviwa, kumbe vuxiyaxiya bya munhu la heleleke, vukwembu, ntiyiso wa moya, kumbe Xikwembu.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Mupfumeri u lava ntokoto wo kongoma, vutivi, kumbe vutlharhi a ntiyisweni wa vukwembu/xikwembu kumbe swikwembu.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Valandzeri va lava tindlela to karhi to hanya, kumbe mikhuva leyi endleriweke ku kurisa mintokoto yoleyo.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Dyondzo ya ku va swin’we ni Xikwembu yi nga hambanisiwa ni mixaka yin’wana ya tidyondzo ta vukhongeri ni ku gandzela hi ku kandziyisa ka yona ntokoto wo kongoma wa munhu hi yexe wa xiyimo xa ku titwa xo hlawuleka, ngopfu-ngopfu xa mfanelo ya ku rhula, vutlharhi, ntsako, kumbe ni ku nyanyuka.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Vusikh i vukhongeri lebyi sukaka ka tiko-nkulu ra Indiya. Byi sungule a xifundzeni xa le Punjab hi lembe-xidzana ra vu-15 ku suka a ku hambaneni ka ntlawa eka ndhavuko wa Mahindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Masikh a languta vukhori bya wona tanihi vukhongeri lebyi hambaneke ni Vuhindu hambi va pfumela leswaku masungulo ni mikhuva i ya Vuhindu.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Masikh a vitana vukhongeri bya vona Gurmat, ku nga rito ra Xipunjab leri vulaka “ndlela ya guru”. Guru i xiphemu xa nkoka xa vukhongeri hinkwabyo bya le Indiya kambe eka Vusikh u teke ku va ka nkoka loku endlaka xisekelo va tidyondzo ta Masikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Vukhongeri byi sunguriwe hi lembe-xidzana ra vu-15 hi Guru Nanak (469–1539). Ku tlheli ku landzela hi ku tlhandlamana ti guru tin’wana ta kaye.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Hambiswiritano, hi June 1956, switshembiso Krushchev swi ringiwile loko mpfilumpfulu a Poland, la vatirhi a va terekela ku kayivela ka swakudya ni ku wungutiwa ka miholo, ku hundzuka ku lwisana loku toloveleke ni Vukhomunisi.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Hambiloko emakumu, Krushchev a rhumeli timovha ta nyimpi ku lulamisa xiyimo, u pfumelelani ni swilaveko swa ikhonomi swin’wana kambe a pfumela ku veka Wladyslaw Gomulka loyi a rhandziwa tanihi holobye-nkulu.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Muganga wa Indus Valley a ku ri muganga wa Nguva ya Koporo ka tiko-nkulu ra Indiya ra le n’walungu-vupela-dyambu yi katsa vunyingi bya Pakistan ya namuntlha ni swifundzha swin’wana a n’walungu-vupela-dyambu Indiya ni le n’walungu-vuxa Afghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Muganga wu kurile a madan’wini ya Nambu wa Indus lowu tekeke vito ra wona kona.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Hambiloko vadyondzi van’wana va anakanyela leswaku hikuva muganga a wu ri kona nakambe emadan’wini ya Nambu wa Sarasvati lowu nga oma sweswi, swi fanerile ku wu vitana Muganga wa Indus-Sarasvati, hambiloko van’wana va wu vitana Muganga wa le Harappan endzaku ka Harappa, ndhawu ya wona yo sungula yo yimburiwa hi va-1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Xiyimo xa vusocha xa mfumo wa Roma xi pfunile eku endliweni ka nhluvuko eka swa vutshunguri.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Madokodela ma sungule ku rhambiwa hi Mufumi Augustus kambe a endla Vuthu ra le Roma ra Vutshunguri ro sungula leswaku ri pfuna endzaku ka le swi nga humelela enyimpini.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Madokodela ya vuhandzuri a a ri ni ntivo wa swidzidzirisi swo hambana-hambana ku hlanganisa ni morphine leyi humaka a mbewini ya swimilana swa poppy ni scopolamine leyi humaka a mbewini ya herbane.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Va vi ni vutshila byo tsema swirho leswaku va ponisa vavabyi ka swilondza leswi pfundzelaka swin’we ni tinsoho ni swa ku rhunga misiha-nkulu leswaku ku hunguta ku khuluka ka ngati.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Eka malembe xidzana yo hlayanyana, mfumo wa Roma wu pfune leswaku kuva ni nhluvuko lowukulu ka swa vutshunguri kambe wu endli vutivi byo tala ka lebyi hi nga na byona namuntlha.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland origami i origami ya wa mpimelo wa leswaku i kupetsa kun’we ntsena loku nga endliwaka hi nkarhi wun’we, kupetsa loku rharhangeneke ngopfu a ku pfumeleriwanga, kambe kupetsa hinkwako kuna tindhawu to kongoma.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Yi sunguriwe hi John Smith hi va-1970 ku pfuna vapetsi vo kala ntokoto kumbe va vuswikoti bya misiha le byitsongo.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Vana va va ni ku xiya rixaka ni mavonelo lama hoxeke hi rixaka va ha ri vatsongo naswona mavonelo lama hoxeke hi rixaka ma khumba ku tikhoma ka vona.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Attention Deficit Disorder “i vuvabyi bya misiha lebyi ndlela leyi tolovelekeke ya ku byi hlamusela i swiyenge swinharhu swa swikombiso leswi katsaka ku va ni magugu, ku kavanyeteka ni ku nga tshamiseki kumbe ku va ni matimba ngopfu”
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: A hi xona xiphiqo xa ku dyondza, kambe i vuvabyi va ku dyondza; byi “khumba 3 kuya eka 5 wa tiphesente eka vana hinkwavo, kumbexana vana vo tala ku ringana 2 ya timiliyoni ya vana va Maamerika”.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Vana lava nga ni ADD va tikeriwa ku dzikisa mianakanyo eka swilo swa ku fana ni ntirho wa xikolo, kambe va swi kota ku nyikela nyingiso eka swilo leswi va swi tsakelaka ku swi endla ku fana ni ku tlanga mintlango kumbe ku languta tipopayi leti va ti rhandzaka kumbe ku tsala swivulwa leswi nga riki ni ku hikahata.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Vana lava hakanyingi va nghena ekhombyeni, hikuva va “ katsekile eku tikhomeni hi ndlela leyi nga ni khombo, va nghena etinyimpini naswona va lwisana ni vulawuri” leswaku va nyanyula byongo bya vona, hikuva byongo bya vona byi nge nyanyuleke hi tindlela leti tolovelekeke.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD yi khumba vuxaka ni tintangha tin’wana hikuva vana van’wana a va twisisi hikwalaho ka yini va endla swilo hi ndlela leyi va swi endlisaka ha yona kumbe ha yini va peleta hi ndlela leyi va endlisaka ha yona kumbe leswaku mpimo wa vona wa ku wupfa wu hambanile.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Tanihi leswi vuswikoti bya ku kuma vutivi ni ku dyondza byi nga cinca hi ndlela leyi swi nga hlamuseriwa laha henhla mpimo lowu vutivi byi nga kumiwa hi byona byi cincile.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Ndlela ya ku kuma rungula a yi hambanile. A ka ha ri ni ntshikelelo eka ku tsundzuka ka munhu, kambe vuswikoti bya ku tsundzuka ndzimana yi leswi nga langutiwa.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Entiyisweni, Ndzhundzunuko wu endle ku cinca lokukulu eka ndlela ya ku dyondza ni ku hangalasiwa ka vutivi
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Ku hambana ni swiharhi swi’nwana, ti homoinid a ta ha tirhisi mavoko ya tona ku famba kumbe ku rhwala ntiko kumbe ku cikinya emirhini.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Voko ni nenge ra chimpanzi ra fana hi vukulu ni ku leha, leswi kombaka ku tirhisiwa ka voko ku rhwala ntiko eku fambeni hi mahlangano ya mavoko.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Voko ra munhu ri komile ku hundza nenge, hi marhambu lama ololokeke.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Masalela ya marhambu ya mavoko lama nga ni malembe ya timiliyoni timbirhi ku fikela eka timiliyoni tinharhu ma komba ku cinca loko ka voko ku suka eku fambeni ku ya eku ma tirhiseni hi ndlela yin’wana
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Vanhu van’wana va pfumela leswaku ku va ni milorho leyi u nga ti endlela ku vona leswaku wa lorha hi ku phindha-phindha ku nga karharisa.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Xivangelo lexikulu xa xiendlakalo lexi i vuyelo bya milorho leyi u vonaka leswaku wa lorha i ku kurisa ku leha ka nkarhi exikarhi ka swiyimo swa REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Hi ti REM to hlayanyana hi vusiku byin’wana ni byin’wna, xiyimo lexi u twaka vurhongo bya ntiyiso ni ku hlakarhela ka miri wa wena ku nga endleki ngopfu leswaku ku hundzuka xiphiqo.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Leswi swi karharisa ku fana ni loko u ta pfuka hi timenete ta makume-mbirhi kumbe makume-nharhu tin’wana ni tin’wana u languta TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Vuyelo byi titshege hi leswaku byongo bya wena byi ringeta kangani ku endla milorho leyi u vonaka leswaku wa lora vusiku byin’wana ni byin’wana.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Swilo a swi fambanga kahle eka Mantariyana le Afrika N’walungu to ho suka kunene. Ku nga si hela vhiki loko Italy ri tivise nyimpi hi Juni 10, 1940, ti-Hussar ta vu-11 ta maBurithani a ti vutle Fort Capuzzo le Libya.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Eka nhlaselo wo tumbelela le vuxeni bya Bardia, maBurithani ma teke Munjiniyarankulu wa Vukhume wa Vuthu wa Muntariyana, Mujenerala Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Hi June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, Mulawurijenerala wa Libya tlhelo loyi a tekiwa a ri mudyandzhaka wa Mussolini, u dlayiwile hi ku baleseriwa hi xihoxo loko a fika eTobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Ntlangu wa manguva lawa wa fensing wu tlangiwa eka swiyenge swo tala, ku suka eka machudeni ya le yunivhesithi ku ya eka vatlangi lava swi dyondzeleke ku fika eka mimphikizano ya Olimpiki.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Hakanyingi ntlangu lowu wu tlangiwa hi vanhu vambirhi,mutlangi lowun’wana a lwa ni mutlangi lowun’wana.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golufu i ntlangu lowu vatlangi va baka bolo hi nhonga leswaku yi ngena eka timbhovo.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Timbhovo ta khume nhungu ti tlangiwa eka xiyenge xo sungula, hakanyingi vatlangi va sungula eka mbhovo wo sungula erivaleni naswona va hetelela eka wa khume nhungu.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Mutlangi loyi a nga na nhlayo ya le hansi yoba, kumbe ku cikinya nhonga, ku fikela ntlangu wu hela wa hlula.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Ntlangu wu tlangiwa emabyanyini, naswona mabyani lama nga ekusuhi na mbhova ma tsemiwa ya va lamatsongo naswona ya vitaniwa rihlaza.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Kumbexana ndlela leyi tolovelekeke ya vupfhumba hi leswi vanhu vo tala va swi hlanganisaka ni vufambi. Vupfhumba byo tihungasa.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Leswi hi loko vanhu va ya eka ndhawu leyi hambaneke ni ya vona ya siku-ni-siku leswaku va wisa ni ku tiphina.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Mabuwu, phaki yo tiphina eka yona na tindhawu to kampa eka tona i tindhawu leti nkarhi wun’wana ti endzelaka hi vapfhumba vo tihungasa.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Loko xikongomelo nkulu xa munhu loko a endzela ndhawu yo karhi ku ri ku tiva matimu ni ndhavuko vupfhumba lebyi byi tiviwa tanihi vupfhumba bya ndhavuko.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Vapfhumba va nga endzela tindhawu to hambana hambana leti miako leyi hlawulekeke ya tiko kumbe va nga yisa nyingiso eka dhawu yin’we ntsena.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Vakholonisi, loko va vona xiendlo lexi, na vona va kombele ku tiyisiwa.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Masocha lama tiyisaka emahlweni a ma katsa ti Hampshire regiments ta vu 1 ni ta vu 3 ta vavanuna va 200, ehansi ka Kolonele John Stark na James Reed (havumbirhi va ve tindhuna nkulu endzaku ka nkarhi).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Vavanuna va Stark va teke tlhelo ra fenisi en’walungu ka mahetelelo ya ndhawu ya vakholonisi.
