text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Loko ku tlakuka ka mati ya lwandle ku ye ehansi ku siye vangwa eMystic River en’walungu-vuxa bya peninsula, hi xihatla va engetele fenisi hi khumbi ro koma ra ribye en’walungwini ri helela emakumu ka mati eribuweni leritsongo.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley kumbe Stark va veke mhandzi ya 100 feet (30 m) emahlweni ka fenisi naswona va lerisa leswaku ku nga vi na loyi a duvulaka ku fikela loko vanhu lava tolovelekeke va hundza.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Kungu ra ma Amerika a ri titshege hi ku hlasela loku hlanganisiweke ku suka eka tindhawu tinharhu to hambana.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Murhangeri nkulu John Cadwalder a a kota ku sungula nhlaselo wa vukanganyisi eka British gamison eBordentown, leswaku a ta sivela ku seketeriwa kun’wana ni kun’wana.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Murhangeri nkulu James Ewing a a teka masocha ya 700 va tlula nkova wa Trenton Ferry, a khoma buloho ra le Assunpink Creek no sivela masocha ya valala leswaku ma nga hundzi.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Vavanuna va nyimpi va 2,400 a va tsemakanya nkova timayile ta nkaye en’walungu wa Trenton, naswona va ti ava hi mintlawa yimbirhi, wun’we ehansi ka Greene na wun’we ehansi ka Sullivan, leswaku va ta hlasela ri nga si xa.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ku cinca loku vaka kona eka ku tsustuma ku suka eka kota ku ya eka hafu ya mayile, rivilo ri heleriwa hi nkoka naswona ku tiyisela swi va swa nkoka.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Entiyisweni nuna loyi a tsutsuma hafu ya mayile ya xiyimo lexi tlakukeke, ku nga helanga na timinete timbirhi, sweswo swi vula leswaku u na rivilo ngopfu, kambe ku tiyisela ku fanele ku dyondziwa eka swilo hinkwaswo.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Ku tsutsumanyana eka ti ndhawu ta ntumbuluko hi nkarhi wa xixika, swin’we ni ku endla vutiolori bya miri wa le henhla, hi yona ndlela ya ku lunghiselela nkarhi wa ku tsutsuma.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Ku dya kahle ntsena a ku nge endli munhu a tsutsume kahle ngopfu, kambe ku yi khumba ngopfu vuswikoti bya ku tsutsuma kahle eka vatsutsumi la vantshwa.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Ku tshama u tiyerile hi ndlela leyinene, ku titoloveta mikhuva leyinene ya kunwa mati, na ku twisisa tindlela to hambana ta ku engetela swiakhi swa miri ku nga pfuna vatsutsumi vo tala va antswisa ndlela leyi va tsutsuma ha yona naswona ku nga endla va tsakela ntlango hi ndlela leyi engeteleleke.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Ku tsutsuma eka ndhawu leyi yi nga lehenga naswona yi nga komanga, i ntlango lowu nga durhiki; kambe, swi tele swilo leswi swi nga ri ntiyiso leswi vuriwaka hi swilo swa ku tlanga leswi lavekaka leswaku u nghenelela eka ntlango.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Switirhisiwa swi nga xaviwa hi ndlela leyi swi laveka ha yona, kambe swi yi cinca ka ntsongo kumbe swi nga yi cinci ndlela leyi munhu a tsutsu ma ha yona.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Vatsutsumi va nga twa nga ku va hlawula switirhisiwa hambiloko swi nga pfuni nchumu.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Athomu yi nga langutiwa tanihi swin’wana swa nkoka ngopfu eku endliweni ka metha.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Hi kuya hi model ya Bohr leyi olovisiweke, i xilo leswi ku tikaka ku swi twisisa leswi katsaka nyukliya ya le xikarhi leyi rhendzeriweke yi ti elektroni, hi ndlela leyi tipulanete ti li rhindzereke ha rona dyambu – Vona Xinepe 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Nyutliliya I na swilo swimbirhi - tinyuturoni na tiporotoni.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Ti phurothoni ti na phositivhi elekitiriki chaji kasi ti nyutironi a ti na chaji. T elekitironi ti na negetivhi elektiriki chaji.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Ku Kamba munhu loyi a kumeke khombo, u fanele u rhanga hi ku kambisisa eka ndhawu leyi ya khombo leswaku u tiyiseka hi ku hlayiseka,
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: U fanele u xiya ku yima ka munhu loyi a weriweke hi khombo tanihi u tshinela ka yena na xin’wana ni xin’wana lexi ku lumkisaka.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Loko u vaviseka u karhi u ringeta ku pfuna, u nga endla xiyimo xi nyanya ngopfu.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Dyondzo yi kume leswaku vuvavyi va mihleketo, ku chava na ku xaniseka hi kona loku endlaka ku vava ni vutsoniwa eka vanhu lava va twa ku vava emhlana.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: A ku ya ntsena vanhu lava khumbiwa hi ku xaniseka eka ti seshini ta vhiki na vhiki ta PA, a ku ngayi vanhu lava va na vuvabyi va mihleketo na va chavaka.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Vanhu lava ava nghenelela eka swilo leswi endliwaka a va lava ku seketeriwa hi ndlela leyi engeteleleke eka ndlela leti a ava twa u vava ha yona leswaku va swi kota ku hambanisa ku vava ka vuvabyi na ku nga titwi kahle loko va famba famba.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Swivono, kumbe ku kota ku vona ku titshege eka swirho swa ku vona kumbe matihlo.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Swi tele ndlela leti hambeneke leti matihlo a endliweke hi tona, leti ti tikaka hi kuya hi leswi swi laviwa hi xivumbiwa.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Maendlelo wa ku hambana ma na vuswikoti lebyi hambaneke, a tikelwa hi tindlela leti hambaneke naswona a wa voni hi ndlela leyi yi fanaka, nakambe a lava swilo leswi hambaneke ku tiva swilo leswi a swi vonaka na swilo leswi swi nga ringaniki leswaku a tirha kahle.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Nhlayo ya ku tshama yi nhlengeletano ya swivumbiwa ya muxaka wun’wana eka ndhawu yo karhi ya ntumbuluko.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Loko vanhu hinkwavo eka ndhawu va fana hi mhaka ya xilo xo karhi xa mbewu, va vitaniwa tanihi monomofiki.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Loko vanhu va kombisa ku hambana ko hlayanyana eka xilo xo karhi, va yi polimofiki.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Vusokobyi lebyi kumeka eka tropika naswona byi macha byi thlela byi tshama eka swiyimo swa ku hambana.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Eka xiyenge xa nomadikhi, vusokobyi lebyi kumeka eka tropika a ti macha hi madyambu hi nhlekani ta yima ti dzima matente.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Kholoni yi sungula xiyenge xa nomadikhi loko swa kudya swi nga kumeki ngopfu. Eka xiyenge lexi, koloni yi endla tindhawu ta ku tshama bya swi nkadyana leti cinciwaka masiku hinkwawo.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Timachi yin’wana ni n’wana ta xiyenge xa nomadikhi ti teka kwalomu 17 ya masiku.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Iyini seli? Vito leri nge “seli” ri huma eka vito ra swo Ntariyani leri nge “sella” leri vulaka “kamara leyi ntsongo” naswona e masungulweni ri te na mhunu loyi u tirha hi ti mikhroskopu loko a langute ku yina ka khokho.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Seli i xi sekelo sa swilo hinkwaswo leswi hanyaka, naswona swivumbiwa hinkwaswo swi endliweke hi seli yinwe kumbe to tala.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Tiseli i xi sekelo ngopfu naswona i swa nkoka eka dyondzo ya vutomi, entiyisweni, minkarhi yo tala ti vataniwa tanihi “swilo leswi vumbaka vutomi”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Fambiselo ra Tinevhe ri hlayisa homostasisi hi ku rhumela rungula hi tinevhe eka mirhhi hinkwawo leswaku ku va ni fambiselo ra ngati naswona ri nga kavanyetiwi.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Rungula leri ra ti nevhe ri nga rhumeriwa hi ku hatlisa swinene eka mirhi hinkwawo leswi pfunaka mirhi leswaku wu hlayiseka eka ku chava kun’wana ni kun’wana.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Swihuhuri swi ba ndhawu leyitsongo loko swi pimanisiwa ni swidzedze swin'wana swa vukari, kambe swi nga onha swilo hinkwaswo leswi swi hlanganaka na swona.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Swihuhuri swi tsuvula minsinya, swi onha tindhlu, naswona swi khukula timovha. Tipesenti timbirhi ta swihuhuri leswi swi na matimba ngopfu swi teka nkarhi wa ku hindza eka tiawara ti nharhu.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Swihuhuri leswi swi na matimba ngopfu swi na moya lowu nga fikaka eka 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Vanhu a va endla va tlhela va tirhisa tilense ku andzisa marito madzana ya malembe.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Hambiswiritano, titeleskophu tama sungulo bya ntiyiso ti endliwe eYuropa loko ku hela lembexidzana ra vu 16.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Titeleskophu leti a ti tirhisa tilense timbirhi leswaku ti endla swilo leswi kule swi vonaka swi ku suhi naswona swi kulu.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Ku va na makwanga ni vutianakanyi swi ti ta tshama swi ri kona naswona hi ntumbuluko ya ma bindzu ku hleketa leswaku loko vanhu vo tala va vuyeriwa ku ta tshama ku ri na swo tala leswi kumekeka hi nkarhi lowu ntsongo loko u na vutianakanyi
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Ha tshemba leswaku vanhu vo tala va ta twisisa leswaku swilo leswinene leswi va fanele ku swi endla nkarhi wo leya yi ku tirhisana kahle na vanhu.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Vanhu vo tala va lorha hi suku leri vanhu va nga ya eka nyeleti yin’wana va vona misava yin’wana, van’wana va ti vutisa leswaku ku na yini kwahalani, va n’wana va tshemba leswaku swilo swin’wana kumbe vutomi vun’wana va pulanethe yin’wana yi nga tshama eka ximilana xin’wana.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Kambe, loko leswi swo endleka kumbexana axi nge endleki nkarhi wo leya. Tinyeleti ti le kule na le kule naswona ku na timayile ta triliyoni exikarhi ka tinyeleti leti ti nga va “makhelwane”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Kumbexana siku rin’wana, vatukulu xinghuwe va wena va tava va yime ehenhla ka misava leyi nga tivekiki sweswi va ti vutisa hi vakokwa wa vona.
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Swiharhi swi endliwe hi tisele to tala. Swi dya swilo naswona swi gayela endzeni. Swiharhi swo tala swa famba famba.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: I swiharhi ntsena leswi nga ni byongo (hambileswi a hi swiharhi hinkwaswo; jellyfish hi xikombiso, a ti na mabyongo).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Swiharhi swi kumeka misava hinkwayo. Swi handza misava, swi hlambela elwandle, swi tlhela swi haha exibakabakeni.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Sele I xilo lexitsongo ngopfu hi xivumbeko ni lexi tirhaka eka xivumbiwa lexi hanyaka (swilo).
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Sele ri huma eka rito ra Xintariyani cella leri vulaka kamara leri tsongo.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Loko u languta swilo leswi hanyaka ehansi ka mayikhirosikopi, u ta swi vona leswaku swi endliwe hi swikwayere switsongo kumbe tibolo.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, mutivi a dyondzo ya bayoloji wale Ngilandhi, u vone swikwayere switsongo eka khokho hi mayikhirosikopi.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: A swi vonaka onge i makamara. A a ri munhu wo sungula ku vona tisele leti feke.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Ti elementi na ti khomphawundi ti nga suka eka xiyimo xin’wana ti ya eka xin’wana handle ko cinca.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nayitirojeni tanihi moya ya ha ri ni swihlawulekisi leswi fanaka ni loko yi ri xihalaki. Loko yi ri eka xiyimo xa xihalaki yi na ntiko kambe ti molekhuli ta ha fana.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Mati i xikombiso xin’wana. Khomphawundi ya mati yi endliwe hi ti athomu timbirhi ta hayidirojini na athomu yin’we ya okisijini.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Yi ni xivumbeko lexi fanaka xa molekhuli hambiloko yi ri moya, xihalaki, kumbe yi tiyile.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Hambileswi xivumbeko xa yona xale handle xo cinca, xivumbeko xa yona xale ndzeni a xi cinci.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Nkarhi I nchumu lowu wu nga kona eka hina hinkwenu, naswona wu khumba hinkwaswo leswi hi swi endlaka kambe swa tika ku wu twisisa.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Nkarhi wu kambisisiwe hi swidyondzeki swa vukhongeri, filosofi, ni swa sayense ku ringana madzana ya malembe.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Hi tokota nkarhi tanihi nongonoko wa swiendlakalo leswi sukaka eka vumundzuku swi hundza eka nkarhi wa sweswi swiya eka nkarhi lowu hundzeke.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Nkarhi wu tlhela wu va ndlela leyi hi ringanisaka ha yona ku leha ka swiendlakalo.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: U nga fungha ndlela leyi nkarhi wu fambaka ha yona hi ku langutisa ku vuyelelana ka xiendlakalo lexi fambaka bya xirhendzevutani. Xiendlakalo lexi fambaka bya xirhendzevutani i xilo lexi endlekaka hi ku phindha phindha minkarhi hinkwayo.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Tikhompyutha masiku lawa ti tirhisiwa ku cinca swinepe ni tividiyo.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Tipopayi leti rharhanganeke ti nga endliwa hi tikhompyutha, naswona muxaka lowu wa tipopayi wu ya wu tirhisiwa swinene eka thelevixini ni tifilimi.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Vuyimbeleri nkarhi wun’wana byi kandziyisiwa hi ku tirhisa tikhompyutha ta xiyimo xa le henhla leswaku ti fambisa ni ku hlanganisa mimpfumawulo yo hambana.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Ku ringana nkarhi wo leha eka lembe xidzana ra vu khume nkaye ni ra makhume mbirhi, a ku tshembiwa leswaku vanhu vo sungula ku tshama eNew Zealand a va ri Vamaori, lava va hloteke swinyenyana leswi vuriwaka moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Mavonelo lama ya kombise leswaku vanhu Vamaori va suke ePolynesia eGreat Fleet va nghena eNew Zealand ku suka aMoriori, va sungula rixaka ro rima.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Hambiswiritano, vumbhoni lebyintswa byi ringanyeta leswaku Vamoriori a va huma ematikweni yale ndzeni ka Maori lava sukeke eNew Zealand va ya eSwihlaleni swa Chatham, va sungula ndhavuko wa vona lowu hambaneke, wu tlhela wu va ni kurhula.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: A ku ri ni nyimba yin’wana eka Swihlala swa Chatham a ku ri Maori lava fambeleke ekule na New Zealand.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: A va tivita Mariori ku ve ni tinyimpi ti ngari tingani naswona eku heteleleni, va Mariori va herisiwile.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Vanhu lava nga ni madzana ya malembe va nghenerile va hi pfunile leswaku hi tlangela swilo leswi hi swikotaka ni leswi hi swi rhandzaka ngopfu hi hala thelo hi kambela leswi hi tsandzaka ni leswi hi hluleke.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Loko ha yingisele vanhu va hi byela switori swa vona, swa ndyangu, ni swa minhlangano, hi vuyeriwe swinene hi rungula ra leswi hundzeke ni vanhu vo karhi lava kuceteleke hi ndlela leyinene kumbe yo biha eka nhlangano.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Hambileswi ku twisisa matimu ya wena swi nga vuriki leswaku u ta twisisa ndhavuko, swa pfuna nyana leswaku munhu a vona leswaku yena u wela kwini eka matimu ya nhlangano.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Loko ku kambisisiwa ku humelela ku tlhela ku kumiwa laha swi nga fambangiki kahle, vanhu lava nga kona va vona hilaha ku dzikeke swilo leswi nhlangano wu yimelaka swona, leswi wu ti yimiseleke ku swi endla ni matimba lama fambisaka nhlangano.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Eka xiyimo lexi, ku tsundzuka swilo leswi hundzeke swa mikhuva ya va n’wamabindzu ni ku humelela loku landzelaka swi pfune vanhu va pfumela ku cinca ni ndlela leyintshwa ya kereke ya kwalaho.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Switori leswi swo humelela swi ehlise ku chava loku a ku ri kona hi ku cinca, ku endle mboyamelo lowunene eka ku cinca ka vumundzuku.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Miehleketo yo dzika i ndlela ya makungu yo lulamisa swiphiqo leyi hlanganisaka mavonelo yo hambana kumbe swiyenge swo karhi ku kuma xitshunxo.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Mhaka nkulu eka ndlela leyi yo ehleketa i rivilo, vutlhari ni ku pakanisa, ni ku kumisisa mintiyiso, ku tirhisa marhengu hi vuntshwa, ku hlengeleta rungula.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Yinhla ya nkoka swinene ya miehleketo leyi hileswaku: ku hava nhlamulo yin’we leyi kongomeke. U anakanya hi tinhlamulo timbirhi, ku nga leyi kongomeke kumbe leyi hoxeke.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Ndlela leyi yo ehleketa yi fambisana ni sayense yo karhi kumbe maendlelo ya ntolovelo.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Vanhu lava nga ni miehleketo ya muxaka lowu va anakanya hi vutlhari, va swi kota ku nhlokohata muxaka ma miehleketo, ku lulamisa swiphiqo ni ku tirha hi swikambelo swa sayense.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Vanhu va nyikiwe swinene eka minxaka hinkwayo loko swi ta eka ku twisisa miehleketo.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Leswi swi vula leswaku hi kota ku vona leswi vanhu van’wana va swi anakanyaka, va swi lavaka, va swi tshembaka, va swi tivaka kumbe ku swi navela.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Eka swilo leswi hinkwaswo, ku twisisa leswi vanhu va swi lavaka i swa nkoka ngopfu. Swi hi pfumelela ku tlhantlha swiendlo swo tala.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Hi xikombiso, loko wo vona un’wana a faya fasitere ra movha, u ta ehleketa leswaku u lava ku yiva movha wa munhu un’wana.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: U fanele a avanyisiwa hi ndlela leyi hambaneke loko a lahlekeriwe hi makhiya ya movha naswona ku ri movha wa yena lowu a ringetaka ku tshova.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI yi sekeriwe eka swiendlakalo leswi vonakaka leswi vuriwaka nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), leyi kumiweke hi va 1930 hi Felix Bloch (a tirha eYunivhesithi ya Stanford) na Edward Purcell (ku suka eYunivhesithi ya Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Eka ngulumelo lowu, matmba ya maginete na magandlati ya rhediyo swi vanga tiathomu leswaku ti humesa mpfumawulo wutsongo wa rhediyo.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Hi lembe ra 1970, Raymond Damadian, dokodela wa vavabyi swin’we mulavisisi wa swa sayense, u kume xisekelo xa ngulumela wa maginete wo teka swifaniso tanihi xitirhisiwa xa vutshunguri.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Malembe ya mune endzhaku ka kwalaho u nyikiwe patente, leyi yi veke yo sungula ku humesiwa eka dyondzo ya MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Hi 1977, Dr. Damadian u hete ku endla sikenara xo sungula xa “mirhi hinkwawo” xa MRI, lexi a xi vitaneke “Indomitable”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Ku vulavurisana loku nga humeleriki hi nkarhi wun’we ku khuthaza leswaku ku va ni ku anakanyisisa no endla eka van’wana.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Ku pfumelela machudeni leswaku ma tirha hi rivilo ra wona vini va tlhela va lawula rivilo ra vuxokoxoko bya madyondziselo.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ku engeta, ku ni swipemelo switsongo swa nkarhi leswi nyikaka matirhelo lama olovaka. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Ku tirhisiwa ka inthanete na World Wide Web swi pfumelela vadyondzi leswaku va kuma vuxokoxoko nkarhi hinkwawo.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Machudeni ma nga tlhela ma rhumela swivutiso eka vadyondzisi eka nkarhi wun’wana ni wun’wana naswona va langutela tinhlamulo to hatlisa, ku ri ni ku yimela nkarhi lowu va nga ta vonana nakambe eka nhlangano lowu landzelaka.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Minkarhi yo hundza eka ximodeni eka dyondzo yi pfumelela ntsuxeko eka swinawanawana. A ku na ndlela yin’we leyinene yo dyondza.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Kahle kahle, a ku na xilo xin’we xa kahle xo xi dyondza. Ku dyondza ku humelela exikarhi ka mudyondzi ni vutivi lebyi tisiweke.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Ntokoto wa hina wa sweswinyana loko swi ta eka tiendlele hi wexe na ku hlamusela rungula, minongonoko ya thelevixini yo dyondzisa yi kombisa yinhla leyi.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Vo tala va hina hi tikuma hi langutise minongonoko ya thelevixini leyi hi byelaka hi fambiselo ro karhi kumbe vutivi lebyi hi nga taka hi byi tirhisile.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: A hi nge pfuki hi tlhantlhe movha, hi aka xihlbye eka jarata ra hina, hi teka riendzo ro ya ePeru hi ya kambela marhumbi ya khale, kumbe hi cinca yindlu ya vaakelani va hina.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Hi ku pfuniwa hi khebula ta fiber leti fambaka e hantsi ka lwandle na sathalayithi ya broadband leyi yi yaka Yuropa, Greenland yi kota ngopfu ku nghena eka intanethe naswona vanhu lava ringanaka na 93% va swi kota ku nghena eka intanethe.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Hotela ya wena kumbe vanhu lava u fikele ka vona (loko u tshama eka yindlu ya vayeni kumbe yindlu ya munhu wun’wana) yi ta va na wifi kumbe PC leyi yi nga na intanethe, naswona tiyindlu hinkwato ti ta va na internet cafe kumbe ndawo yin’wana leyi ku na wifi leyi yi tirhisiwaka hi wun’wana ni wun’wana.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Hilaha swi kombisiweke laha henhla, hambi leswi rito “Eskimo” ri pfumeleriwaka eUnited States, ri tekiwa ri nga amukeleki eka vanhu vale Arctic, ngopfu ngopfu eKhanada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Hambileswi u nga kumaka vanhu lava vulavulaka xiGreenlandic va tirhisa rito leri, vahlapfa va fanele va papalata ku tirhisa rito leri.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Vanhu lava humaka eGreenland va ti vita vaInuit na vaKalaalleq (vunyingi Kalaallit) eKhanada, muGreenlander, eGreenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Vugevenga, ku venga vanhu va matiko man’wana, a swi tiveki eGreenland. Hambikuri emadorobeni a ku na “tindhawu to chavisa.”
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Maxelo xo titimela kumbexana hi wona khombo leri munhu a nga hlanganaka na rona loko a nga ma lunghekelanga.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Loko u endzela Greenland hi xixika (leswi loko uya uya en’walungwini, ku yaka ku titimela) swi lava u teka mpahla yo tala yo kufumela.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Loko masiku yo tala nhlikanhi wu va ni tiawara to leha swi nga endla leswaku muhu a nga etleli nkarhi lowu ringaneke naswona sweswo swi nga vanga swiphiqo swa rihanyo.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Hi ximumu, tivonele eka tinsuna ta kwale. Hambileswi ti nga cheriki mavabyi, ta tinga.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Hambileswi ekhonomi ya San Francisco yi susumetiwaka hi leswi ri nga ndhawu leyi kokaka vapfhumba emisaveni hinkwayo, ikhonomi ya yona yi titshege hi swo tala.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Tindzawulo leti tlholaka vanhu vo tala i mintirho yo dzondzeriwa, mfumo, swa timali, swo xavisa, ni swa vupfhumba.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Ndlela leyi yi kombisiwaka ha yona eka vuyimbeleri, tifilimi, matsalwa ni ndhavuko lowu dumeke swi pfunile leswaku doroba ni tindhawu ta rona to hlawule ka ti tiviwa misava hinkwayo.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco yi tumbuluxe miako yo tala ya vupfhumba, laha ku katsekaka tihotela, tindhawu to dyela ni tindhawu to khoma tinhlengeletano eka tona ta xiyimo xale henhla.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco yi tlhela yi va ndhawu ya kahle swinene etikweni leyi nga na swakudya swa le Asiya: Khoriya, Thayi, Indiya, na Japani.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Ku famba uya eWalt Disney swi yimela riendzo lerikulu ra vukhongeri eka mindyangu yo tala yale Amerika.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Riendzo leri "tolovelekeke" ri katsa ku tirhisa swihaha mpfuka leswi yaka e Orlando International Airport, ku famba hi bazi uya kumbe u vuya ehotela ya Disney, u heta kwalomu ka vhiki u nga si huma eka miako ya Disney, no vuyela ekaya.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Ku na swilo swo tala ngopfu swo hambana hambana leswi kumekaka, kambe leswi swi tshama swi ri swa nkoka eka vanhu lava nge ndzi endzela "Disney World".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Mathikithi yo tala ya xavisiwe eka inthanete hi ku tirhisa tiwebusayiti ta ti okixini to fana na eBay kumbe Craigslist ti tirhisiwa ka tsongo hi mathikiti lama tirhaka masiku yo tala.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Hambileswi ndlela leyi yi tolovelekeke, yi yirisiwile hi Disney: mathikithi a ya hundziseriwi.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: U fanele u kuma mpfumelelo wo dzima tende ra wena emalayinini ya le Grand Canyon.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Mimpfumelelo yi pimiwe leswaku yi sirhelela khenyon, naswona yi kumeka eka siku ro sungula ra n’wheti, eka tin’wheti ta mune ku nga si fika n’wheti yo sungula.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Hikwalaho, loko u lava mpfumelelo wa malayini lama ya nga talangiki vanhu hi May wu kumeka hi 1 Jan.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Tiyindlu leti kumekaka eka tindhawu leti ti dumeke, to fana na Bright Angel Campground leti ti nga ethlelo ka Phantom Ranch, hakanyingi ti tala hi swikombelo swa ku buka hi siku ro sungula leri ti pfuriwaka ha rona.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Mpfumelelo lowu wu vekeriweke vanhu lava fikaka wu pimiwile, naswona wu kumeka hikuya hi leswaku hi wihi a nga sungula ku fika.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Ku nghena eDzongeni wa Afrika hi movha I ndlela leyi hlamarisaka yo vona ku saseka ka ndhawu leyi no nghena eka tindhawu leti tolovelekeke ta vapfhumba.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Leswi swi nga endliwa hi ku tirhisa movha lowu tolovelekeke loko u kunguhate kahle kambe 4x4 yi ringanyetiwa ngopfu naswona tindhawu to tala ti fikeleleka hi movha wa 4x4 wa mavhilwa yale henhla.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Swi veki emiehleketweni loko u ri karhi u kunguhate leswaku hambileswi Dzonga wa Afrika wu tiyeke matiko yale kusuhi na yona a ma tiyangi.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Swilaveko swa vhisa ni timali ta kona swi titshege hi tiko naswona swi susumetiwa hi tiko leri u humaka eka rona.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Tiko rin’wana ni rin’wana ri na milawu yo hlawuleka leyi vulaka leswi u nga swi rhwalaka emovheni swa xilamulela mhangu.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls i doroba leri nga evupela dyambu bya Zimbabwe, ku tsemakanya hile ndzilikanini ku suka eLivingstone, Zambia, Nile kusuhi na Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Doroba ri tshame ekusuhi na mahovohovo, naswona hi wona ya kokaka vanhu swinene, kambe ndhawu leyi yo tsakisa vapfhumba yi pfumelela vanhu lava rhandzaka swo famba ni lava rhandzaka ku vona tindlela to tala to tshama nkarhi wo leha.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Hi nguva ya mpfula (November kuya eka March), mpimo wa mati wu va wu ye ehenhla naswona mahovohovo ma ta wisa mati hi ndlela yo tsakisa.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Wa tiyisekisiwa leswaku u ta tsakama loko u tsemakanya buloho kumbe u famba ekusuhi ni mahovohovo.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Hi tlhelo rin’wana, mati ya tlakuke ngopfu lerova u nge koti ku vona mahovohovo kahle—hi mati hinkwawo!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Ribye ra Tutankhamun (KV62). Ku nga endleka leswaku KV62 hi rona ribye ra le enkoveni leri tiviwaka ngopfu, ndhawu leyi kombisaka leswi kumiweke hi Howard Carter hi 1922 loyi a kumeke ribye ra xitsundzuxo ra hosi leyitsongo leri khomaneke.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Hambiswiritano, loko ribye ra vuhosi ra Tutankhamun ri pimanisiwa na man’wana a swi talanga swilo leswi u nga swi vonaka loko u vhaka hikuva i rintsongo naswona a ri khavisiwangi ngopfu.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Munhu wun’wana ni wun’wana loyi a tsakelaka ku vona vumbhoni bya ku onhaka ka mummy hi nkarhi loyi a ku ringanyetiwa ku yi susa eka bokisi u ta dzana hikuva ku vonaka nhloko na makatla ntsena.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Swilo swa manyunyu swa ribye a swa ha ri kona, kambe swi susiwile eka Muziyam yama Egipta eCairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Vayeni lava va nga na nkarhi lowuntsongo va ku antswa a va ya kun’wanyana.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, leyi 12 km edzongeni wa vupela dyambu ya Siem Reap. Tempele leyi yale henhla ka xintshabyana yi akiwe eku heleni ka lembe xidzana ra vu 19, hi nkarhi wa ku fuma kahosi Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Atimosifiye leyi baseke ya tempele na ku vona tiva ya Tonle Sap yi endle u nga tisoli hi ku khandziya ntshava.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Ku vhakela ndhawu leyi ku nga hlanganisiwa na riendzo ra xikepe ra kuya eka tiva.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Loko u hundza hile Angkor swa laveka leswaku u nghena eka thempele hikwalaho u fanele u ta na phaspoti ya wena loko u ya eTonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yerusalema i doroba nkhulu ra Israyele naswona hi yona leyi kulu, hambiloko matiko wo tala na United Nations ya nga yi languti tanihi doroba nkhulu ra Israyele.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Doroba ra khale ra le Judean Hills ri na matimu lama tsakisaka ya swilo leswi endlekeke eka magidi ya malembe.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Doroba leri ra kwetsima eka vukhongeri byinharu lebyi pfumelaka leswaku ku ni xikwembu xin'we ntsena – Vuyuda, Vukreste, Vuislam, naswona yi tirha tanihi ntsindza ya moya, ya vukhongeli, na ya ndhavuko.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Hikwalaho ka leswi vukhongeri byi nga bya nkoka ngopfu eka doroba leri ngopfu ngopfu ti ndhawu to tala ta Old City, Yerusalema i yinw’ana ya ti ndhawu leti vapfhumba va fikelaka ka yona.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yerusalema yi na tindhawu to tala leti kombisaka matimu, swilo swa khale, na ndhavuko, swin’we na tindhawu ta ku xava leti tsakisaka leti tshamaka ti tele, ti café, na tindhawu ta ku dyela.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador yi lava leswaku vanhu vale Cuba va kuma papila ra xirhambo va nga si nghena eEcuador hi mavala ya swihaha mpfuka swa matiko yo hambana hambana kumbe tindhawu leti ku tsarisiwaka eka tona.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Papila leri ri fanele ri vekiwa enawini hi Vutirheli byo Timhaka tale Handle byale Ecuador.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Swilaveko leswi swi endleriwe leswaku ku ta va na ku hleleka loko ku fambiwa eka matiko lawa mambirhi.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Vanhu va le Cuba lava nga na makhadi ya rihlaza ya le US va fanele va endzela Ehofisini ya Vuyimeri bya Ecuador leswaku va ta hundzisiwa eka xilaveko lexi.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Phasipoto ya wena yi ta tirha tinhweti ta 6 endzhaku ka masiku lawa u nga ta famba ha wona. Loko u vuya u fanele u va na tikhithi leri nga ta komba leswaku u tshame masiku mangani.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Maendzo ma chipile loko mi famba hi mintlawa, kutani loko u famba u ri wexe kumbe ni munghana wun’we ringeta ku tihlanganisa ni van’wana mi va ntlawa va vanhu va mune kumbe va ntsevu swi ta antswa.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Kambe sweswo swi nga ku vilerisi, hikuva mikarhi yo tala vafhumba va hlanganiswa leswaku va tata mimovha.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Kahlekahle swi vonaka ku ri kungu ro endla leswaku vanhu va vona onge va fanele va engetela mali.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Emakumu ka n’walungu wa Machu Picchu ku ni ntshava yo leha, leyi minkarhi yo tala vanhu tekaka swifaniso leswi vonakaka onge i marhumbi.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Loko wa ha khandziya ntshava leyi u nga yi nyaja kambe loko u ya u kandziya swi ya swi tika, kambe munhu la nga tiyanyana a nga yi khandziya hi timinete ta 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Ku vekiwe maribye yo famba eka wona kambe exigangeni ku ni tinsimbi leti munhu a nga khomelelaka eka tona.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Hilaha swi vuriweke hakona, langutela ku hefemuteka, loko u kandziya exigangeni, kambe ku nga va ni nghozi ngopfungopfu loko ku tsakama.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Ku ni mabakwa lawa u faneleke u hundza eka wona loko u ri ekusuhi ni le henhlahenhla ka tshava, wona ma le hansi kambe u fanele u manyukuta.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Loko u lava ku ti vona kahle tindhawu ni swiharhi swa le Galapagos swi kahle ku tirhisa xikepe, hilaha Charles Darwin a endleke hakona hi 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Ku ni ku tlula 60 wa swikepe leswi fambaka ematini ya Galapagos hi ku ya hi ku hambanahambana ka vukulu bya swona leswi kandziyisaka 8 wa vanhu ku ya eka 100.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Vanhu vo tala va buka ka ha ri ni karhi (tanihi leswi swikepe swi tshamaka swi tele hi minkarhi leyi ku nga bizi).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Tiyiseka leswaku loyi a nga ta ku bukela u swi tiva kahle swikepe swa le Galapagos.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Sweswo swi ta endla leswaku leswi u swi rhandzaka kumbe leswi u nga swi tsakeriki swi fambisana ni xikepe lexi a nga ta xi buka.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Loko mfumo wa Spain wu nga si fika hi 16th century, n’walungu wa Chile a wu fumiwa hi mfumo wa Inca naswona Maarucania (Mapuche) a va tshama exikarhi ni le dzongeni wa le Chile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche ku ve van’wana eka mintlawa ya Maamerika, lava a va nga ma tirhisi ngopfu mavulavulelo ya le Spain kukondza Chile ri va ni ntshunxeko.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Hambileswi ku vuriweke leswaku Chile yi tshunxeke hi 1810 (tinyimpi ta Napoleonic ti siye Spain yi nga ha ri na vurhangeri bya le xikarhi ku ringana malembe yo karhi), Spain a yi hluriwanga hi ku kongoma ku fikela hi 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominican Republic (hi Spaniya: República Dominicana) i tiko ra Kharibiya leri tsemaka hi le vuxeni-xikarhi ka xihlala xa Hispaniola, leri ri avelanaka na Haiti
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Handle ka lwandle leri ringana sava ro basa na tintshava, tiko leri i kaya ra doroba ra khale ra le Yuropa eAmerika, leri sweswi ringa xiyenge xa Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Vanhu vo sungula ku tshama eka xihlala i maTaíno na maKharibiya. MaKharibiya a va ri vanhu lava vulavulaka Xiawaraka lava fikeke kwalomu ka 10,000 BCE.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Eka malembe mangari mangani ku fike vakambisisi vale Yuropa, nhlayo ya vanhu va Mataino yi hunguteke swinene hikwalaho ka leswi va hluriweke hi vanhu va le eSpaniya.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Hi kuvula ka Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) exikarhi ka 1492 na 1498 vahluri va le eSpaniya va dlaye kwalomu ka 100,000 wa Mataíno.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Ndhawu leyi a yi akiwe leswaku yi va ntsindza wa vanhu va vukhongeri hi va 17th-century, sweswi muako lowu nga sala i Templo de San Diego.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Sweswi wu tirha tanihi plaza, naswona ku tshama ku ri bizi vusiku ni nhlikanhi.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Ku ni tirhesturente to tala leti nga rhendzeleka ntanga, naswona ninhlikani ni namadyambu ku ni tikhonsete leti voniwaka mahala ku sukela exikarhi ka gazebo.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Ndhawu yo ntswontswana). Tibalchoni timbirhi leyi a ti hambanisiwa hi 69 wa tisentimitara i kaya ra munhu wa khale loyi a a dume hi timhaka ta marhandzu.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Loko u ri ni tipeni tingari tingani vana va nga ku byela xitori xa kona.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island i ndhawu yo duma leyi vanhu va yaka eka yona ku ya tiphina ku ringana siku kumbe hi mahelo vhiki, kwalaho ku ni kayaking, ku khandziyiwa tintshava, tirhesturente ni swin’wana swo tala.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Ndhawu leyi yi le Howe Sound loko wa ha ku huma eVancouver, naswona u hatla u fika eka yona loko u khandziya mathekisi lama sukaka eGranville Island ehansi ka doroba ra Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Lava rhandza ku tiphina ehandle, va swi rhandza ku famba hi ndlela yo leha swinene.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1.5 wa tiawara loko u famba hi movha u suka eVancouver) swa durha ku famba kwalaho hikwalaho ka tiolimpiki to duma swinene leti veke kona hi 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Hi xixika, u nga tiphina hi ku rheta etiayisini eNorth Amerika, naswona hi ximumu u nga tiphina hi ku famba hi bayisikiri etintshaveni.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: U fanele u kombela Pfumelelo ka ha ri ni nkarhi. U fanele u va ni pfumelelo loko u lava ku etlela eSirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena i ndhawu yin’we ntsena leyi ku tshamaka varindzi va swiharhi leyi nyikaka vanhu ndhawu yo tlela ni swakudya swo hisa ku engetela eka ku khempa. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos ko va ndhawu yo khempa ntsena a va nyiki swakudya.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: U nga swi kota ku kombela mpfumelelo hi ku kongoma eka kwale Ndhawini ya Marhenja ePuerto Jiménez, kambe a va teki khadi ra xikweleti (credit cards).
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: ENtangeni wa (MINAE) a va nge ku nyiki pfumelelo loko ka ha sale n’hweti leswaku u ya.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol yi pfumelela munhu a buka hi mali yo ringana US$30, kumbe $10 ya ku va kona siku rin’we; leswaku u kuma vuxokoxoko yana eka peji ra vona ra Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Swihlala swa Cook swi le tikweni ra swihlala naswona swi tirhisana kahle na New Zealand, leyi kumekaka ePolynesia, exikarhi ka le dzongeni wa South Pacific Ocean.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: I swihlala swa 15 leswi nga longoloka swi tlhela swi hangalaka kwalomu ko tlula tikhilomitara ta 2.2 km2 wa timiliyoni eLwandle.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Leswi swi tirhisaka nkarhi wo fana ni wa le Hawaii, ku pfa ku ehleketiwa leswaku swihlala leswi swi le “hansi ka Hawaii”
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Hambileswi swi nga switsongo, swi tsundzuxa vaendzi lavakulu lava huma eHawaii nkarhi lowu a swi nga si kota ku tiyimela naswona swi nga si va ni tihotela letikulu ta vaendzi ni ku hluvuka kun’wana loku endlekeke.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Xihlala xa Cook a xi na madoroba kambe xi vumbiwa hi swihlala swa 15 swo hambanahambana. Leswikulu swa kona i Rarotonga na Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Ematikweni lama hluvukeke namuntlha, vutshamo lebyi nga ni mubedo wa manyunyu ni swakudya swo fihlula swa xiyimo xa le henhla se swi endliwa hi ndlela ya vutshila swinene.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Hi ntolovelo ti B&B to durha swinene ti phikizana hi swilo swimbirhi leswikulu: swo funengela ha swona ni swakudya swo fihlula.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Hikwalaho, etindhawini ta manyunyu u nga kuma swo funengela ha swona swa xiyimo xa le henhla swinene, kumbexana nkumba lowu rhungiweke hi voko kumbe mubedo wa xikhale.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Swakudya swo fihlula swi nga ha katsa swakudya swo nandziha leswi vaka kona hi ku ya hi tinguva endhawini yoleyo kumbe swakudya swo nandziha swinene leswi n’wini wa ndhawu yoleyo a dumeke hi ku swi lunghiselela vapfhumba vakwe.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Ndhawu ya kona yi nga ha va muako wa khale wa matimu lowu nga ni fanichara ya khale, mintanga leyi lunghisiweke kahle ni xidziva xo hlambela eka xona.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Ku nghena emovheni wa wena ivi u teka riendzo ro leha swa tsakisa swinene hileswi movha wa wena wu ku oloviselaka swilo.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Ku hambana ni timovha letikulu, a swi kanakanisi leswaku ana se u swi toloverile ku chayela movha wa wena naswona wa wu tivela.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Ku dzima tende endhawini yin’wana kumbe edorobeni lerikulu swi nga ku kokela mahlo hi ku olova.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Hi ku komisa, ku tirhisa movha wa wena i ndlela leyinene ngopfu yo teka riendzo ro leha kambe a swi talanga ku va u etlela eka yona.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Ku etlela emovheni swa koteka loko u ri ni movha lowukulu wo tanihi vheni, SUV, Sedan kumbe Station Wagon lowu nga ni switulu leswi etlerisiwaka.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Tihotela tin’wana ti ni switimela swa khale leswi a swi famba hi makala swin’we ni swikepe swa le lwandle; emahlweni ka Nyimpi yo Sungula ya Misava, hi lembexidzana ra vu 19 kumbe eku sunguleni ka lembexidzana ra vu 20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Eka tihotela teto a ku tshama swifumi ni vanhu va ndhuma va hi nkarhi wolowo naswona hakanyingi a va dya swakudya swo lalela swa kahle ni ku tihungasa nivusiku.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Nhundzu ya khale, ku pfumaleka ka tindhawu ta manguva lawa to tihungasa ni swilo swo karhi swa khale i swin’wana swa swilo leswi nga eka tona.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Hambileswi hakanyingi ti nga ta vanhu vo karhi, minkarhi yin’wana ti rhurhela tihosi ni vachaviseki.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Muvalangi loyi a fuweke ni swikunwana a nga ha ehleketa hi ku teka riendzo ro endzela misava hinkwayo hi xihahampfhuka, a famba a etlela eka to tala ta tihotela teto.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Fambiselo ra tindhawu to amukela ni ku hungasa vavalangi i nhlangano lowu hlanganisaka vavalangi ni vaaki va madoroba lawa va nga ta ma endzela.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Ku joyina fambiselo ra tindhawu teto hakanyingi swo lava ntsena u tata fomo ya le ka inthanete; hambileswi mafambiselo man’wana ma nyikela kumbe ma lavaka tindlela leti engetelekeke to tiyisisa.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Kutani ku rhumeriwa nxaxamelo wa vanhu lava rhurhelaka vavalangi lowu printiweke kumbe lowu nga eka inthanete, minkarhi yin’wana wu ri ni mavito ya vavalangi ni leswi va swi vuleke hi vanhu lava va va rhurheleke.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing yi sunguriwe hi January 2004 endzhaku ka loko muendli wa tiprogreme ta khompyuta Casey Fenton a kume xihahampfhuka xo chipa xo ya eIceland kambe a nga ri na yona ndhawu yo tshama.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: U rhumele swichudeni swa le yunivhesiti ya kwalaho imeyili ivi a kuma vanhu vo tala lava n’wi tshembiseke ku n’wi nyika ndhawu yo tshama mahala.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Tihositela ti rhurhela ngopfu vantshwa – vaendzi lava nga emalembeni ya kwalomu makume mambirhi – kambe hi ntolovelo u nga va kuma ni vavalangi lava kuleke kwalaho.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: A swi tolovelekanga ku vona mindyangu leyi nga ni vana, kambe tihositela tin’wana ta yi pfumelela mindyangu ku tshama eka makamara ya le tlhelo.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Doroba ra le Beijing eChayina ri ta rhurhela Mintlangu ya Tiolimpiki ya Xixika hi 2022, leswi nga ta endla leswaku ri va doroba ro sungula ku rhurhela Tiolimpiki ta ximumu ni ta xixika.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing yi ta khoma nkhuvo wo sungula ni wo gimeta mintlangu yoleyo swin’we ni mintlangu ya le ayisini leyi khomeriwaka endzeni.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Mintlangu yin’wana ya le ayisini yi ta khomeriwa eTaizicheng le Zhangjiakou, kwalomu ka tikhilomitara ta 220 (140 miles) kusuka eBeijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Titempele to tala ti va ni nkhuvo wa Lembe ni Lembe lowu sungulaka eku heleni ka November ivi wu hela exikarhi ka May, lowu endliwaka hi ndlela leyi hambaneke hi ku ya hi khalendara ya lembe ni lembe ya tempele ya kona.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Minkhuvo ya titempele to tala yi tlangeriwa tanihi xiphemu xa tempele xo hlanganisa malembe kumbe ku tlangela siku ro velekiwa ra xikwembu lexi rhangelaka kumbe xiendlakalo xihi ni xihi xin’wana lexikulu lexi fambisanaka ni tempele.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Minkhuvo ya tempele ya Kerala ya tsakisa swinene ku yi vona, ni ntlawa wa tindlopfu leti khavisiweke ti ri karhi ti famba, ntlawa wa vayimbeleri va orchestra va le tempeleni ni minkhuvo yin’wana.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: World’s Fair (leyi hi ntolovelo yi vitaniwaka World Exposition kumbe Expo hi ku komisa) i nkhuvo lowukulu wa matiko wa vutshila ni sayense.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Matiko lama hlanganyelaka ma lunghiselela minkombiso ya vutshila ni ya dyondzo eka timbala ta mintlangu ta tiko leswaku ma kombisa swiphiqo swa misava kumbe ndhavuko ni matimu ya matiko ya vona.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: International Horticultural Expositions i swiendlakalo swo hlawuleka leswi kombisaka swiluva, mintanga ya swimilana ni swilo swin’wana ni swin’wana leswi fambisanaka ni swimilana.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Hambileswi hi ku ya hi nawu swi nga khomiwa lembe ni lembe (hilaha swi nga hakona ematikweni yo hambanahambana), kambe entiyisweni a swi endliwi.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Swiendlakalo leswi hi ntolovelo swi teka nkarhi lowu nga exikarhi ka tin’hweti tinharhu ni ta tsevu naswona swi khomiwa etindhawini leti nga ehansi ka 50 wa tihekitara.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Ku tirhisiwe tifilimi ta mixaka yo hambanahambana emalembeni lama hundzeke. Filimi leyi tolovelekeke ya 35 mm (36 x 24 mm negative) hi yona leyi tolovelekeke.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Hi ntolovelo yi nga tatisiwa hi ku olova loko yi ku helerile naswona yi ni resolution leyi ringanakanyana ni leya sweswi ya DSLR.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Tikhemera tin’wana ta filimi ya muxaka wa kahle ti tirhisa muxaka wa 6 x 6 cm, leyi hi ku kongoma ku nga 56 x 56 mm negative.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Ti va ni resolution leyi andzisiweke ka mune ya 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Ku kuma xifaniso xa kahle swa tika eka muteki wa swifaniso swi nga ha lavana ri ni nkateko, a lehisa mbilu, a ri ni ntokoto ni switirhisiwa leswinene.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Minkarhi yo tala ntirho wo teka swiharhi swifaniso a wu tekeriwi nhlokweni kambe ku na swo tala leswi nga vuriwaka hi xifaniso xa kona.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Ku teka swiharhi swifaniso minkarhi yo tala swi lava ku tirhisa khamera ya tilense to leha hambileswi swilo swo fana ni swinyenyana kumbe swiharhi leswitsongo swi lavaka tilense tin'wana.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Swiharhi swo tala leswi nga riki swa tiko rero swa kala ku swi kuma naswona mintanga yin'wana yi na milawu mayelana ni ku teka swifaniso leswaku munhu a ta swi xavisa.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Swi nga endleka swiharhi swi ri na tingana kumbe swi kariha. Swi nga endleka maxelo ma titimela, ku hisa kumbe maxelo ma nga ri kahle hi ndlela yo karhi.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Laha misaveni ku ni tindzimi to hambanahambana to tlula 5 000 ku katsa ni tin'wana to tlula makume mambirhi leti vulavuriwaka hi vanhu vo tlula 50 wa timiliyoni kumbe ku tlula.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Minkarhi yo tala swa olova ku twisisa marito lama tsariweke kunene ku tlula lama vuriweke. Leswi swi tano ngopfungopfu eka marito lama mikarhi yo tala ma tikaka ku ma vula kahle.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Eka matiko yo tala vanhu va kona va xi vulavula kahle Xilungu, kambe u nga kuma leswaku a va na vutivi byo tala ngopfungopfu vanhu lavatsongo.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Loko swi koteka, ehleketa hi munhu wa le Manchester, wa le Bostoniya ni wa le Sydney va tshame etafuleni va ri karhi va dya swin'we endhawini yo xavisa swakudya eToronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Va le ku byelaneni ka switori swa laha va humaka kona va tirhisa mavulavulelo ya kona ni ririmi ra vona ra le xitarateni.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Ku xava swakudya eswitolo swo xavisa swakudya swi chipini. Loko ku sweka swi nga koteki, swi boha munhu a xava swakudya leswi se swi swekiweke.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Tindhawu to xavisa swakudya se ti ya ti xavisa swakudya swo hambanahambana swo swekiwa. Tin'wana ti veka na timakhrowevhi eswitolo kumbe ti lava tindlela tin'wana to kufumeta swakudya.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Eka matiko man'wana kumbe switolo swin'wana ku va ku ri na rhesturente yin'we endzeni ka swona, mikarhi yo tala yi va yi nga endleriwanga ku tshama u dyela kona naswona yi chipile.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Endla tikopi ta milawu ya wena ni ta ni vuxokoxoko bya ndzindzakhombo naswona u tshama u ri tona.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Ti fanele ti va ni imeyili adirese ya ndzindzakhombo ni tinambara to kota ku fonela ematikweni ya le handle loko u lava switsundzuxo/kumbe u lava ku endla swikombelo.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Kopi yin'wana ya swilo leswi u nga tihlayisela yona eka online (hi ku tiimeyilela yona yi ri ni swilo leswi lavekaka kumbe u yi hlayisa eka "cloud").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Loko u famba ni Laptop kumbe tablet seyivha kopi ya wena eka swona kumbe u va na disk (u ta kota ku yi kuma hambi u nga ri na inthanete).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Nakambe u nga nyika lava u fambaka na vona kopi ya milawu yoleyo ni maxaka kumbe vanghana lava nga swi tsakelaka ku ku pfuna ekaya.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Xiharhi lexi vitaniwaka moose kumbe elk hi xinghezi hi ntumbuluko a xi levi, kambe xa ti lwela loko xi titwa xi xungetiwa.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Loko vanhu va vona onge xiharhi lexi xa moose a xi na khombo, va nga ha xi tshinelela ngopfu ivi swi va veka ekhombyeni.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Lava nwaka byalwa va byi n'wa hi mpimo lowu ringaneke. Byalwa a byi hi khomi ku fana, ku tiva mpimo lowu u faneleke u wu n'wa i swa nkoka.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Loko munhu a n'wa byalwa ngopfu swi nga n'wi vangela vuvabyi bya xivindzi, a fa matihlo kumbe rifu. Swi va na khombo swinene loko munhu a n'wa byalwa lebyi nga riki nawini.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Swipiriti nga riki nawini swi ni swilo leswi nga ni khombo swo tanihi methonol, leswi nga dlayaka munhu matihlo kumbe swi n'wi dlaya hi mathonsi ma nga ri mangani ntsena.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Maghilazi ya matihlo ma nga va ma chipile ematikweni man'wana, ngopfungopfu laha swilo swi nga durhiki hileswi ikhonomi yi nga le hansi.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Swi nga va kahle loko wo kambela matihlo ya wena ekaya ngopfungopfu loko u ri na ndzindzakhombo wo hakelela matihlo kutani u famba na papila ra kona leswaku ri ya tatiwa kwala u yaka kona.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Maghilazi yo durha lama u nga ma kumaka kwalaho ma nga va na swiphiqo swimbirhi; ma nga ha va ma nga ri ya ntiyiso naswona loko ma ri ya ntiyiso ma nga durha ku tlula laha u humaka kona hileswi ma nga lo rhumeriwa.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kofi i yin’wana ya swilo leswi xavisiwaka swinene emisaveni hinkwayo naswona u nga kuma mixaka yo tala ya yona eswifundzeni swa ka n’wina.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Hambiswiritano, ku ni tindlela to tala to nwa kofi emisaveni hikwayo leti u nga taka u nga ti soli loko wo tiringeta.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Ntlangu lowu vuriwaka canyoning (kumbe: canyoneering)i ku va u ya ehansi ka xinkobyana lexi nga ha va ka xi tele hi mati kumbe xi nga ri na mati.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Ntlangu wa canyoning wu katsa ku hlambela, ku khandziya ni ku tlula- kambe leswaku u wu endla wu lava leswaku u va u leteriwile kumbe u va u hanye kahle (a swi fani ni ku khandziya maribye, ku hlambela nintlangu wo rheta eka gamboko).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Ku hayika i ntlango lowu katsaka ku famba etindhawini ta ntumbuluko naswona mikarhi yo tala ku ni tindlela leyi endliweke to hayika eka tona.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Ku hayika ninhlikani swikatsa ku famba riendzo leri nga le hansi ka khilomitara kumbe ro leha leri nga hetiwaka hi siku.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Swi lava ku lunghiselela leswaku u ya ku hayikeni naswona vanhu lava hanyeke kahle va tiphina hi ku hayika.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Mindyangu leyi nga ni vana lavatsongo yi endla malunghiselelo lama engetelekeke, kambe ku tihungasa ehandle swa koteka hambiloko vari ni vana lavatsongo kumbe lava hariki eka swikolo swa le hansi.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Ku ni kwalomu ka mihlangano yo tsutsuma ya kwalomu ka 200 emisaveni hinkwayo. Yo tala ya yona ya tiyimela.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.
