text: Lava vuyeriwaka eka mapfhumba ya misava hinkwayo yo tsutsuma va nhlanganise vatsutsumi lava valangaka ekamatikonkulu ya mune.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Mapfhumba yo tsutsuma ya le Barcelona ni ya le Copenhagen ma joyiniwe hi mapfhumba yo tsusuma ya le Prague ni man’wana.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Ku ni leswi u faneleke u ehleketisisa hi swona loko u nga si endzela endhawini yin’wana.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Loko u endza, u nga languteli leswaku swilo swi ta fana ni le kaya. Mahanyelo, milawu, swakudya, nkhuluko wa timovha, byietlelo, ni ririmi swi nga ha hambana ni swa laha u humaka kona.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Leswi hi leswi ufaneleke u swi tsundzuka, leswaku u nga nyami kumbe ku nga tsakeli endlelo ra kwalaho.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Vahleri va maendzo i khale va ri kona ku sukela hi lembexizhana ra vu 19. Muhleri wa maendzo wa pfuna loko u lava ku ya etindhawini leti nga faniki hi ndhavuko, ririmi kumbe xiyimo xa ekhonomi xa tindhawu leti a wu yile.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Hambileswi vahleri vo tala va hlelelaka vanhu tindhawu to karhi, vo tala va hlela maendzo yo karhi ntsena, hi ku hi ntsengo wo karhi wa ni laha ku yiwaka kona.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Swi nga va kahle ku tirhisa muhleri loyi a toloveleke ku hlela maendzo yo fana ni lawa u ma lavaka.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Xiya leswaku u navetisa maendzo ya njhani, eka webisite kumbe efasitereni ra xitolo.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Ku ni tindlela to tala to valanga misava leti nga durhiki, leswaku u ti tsakisa ni loko swi ku boha.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Ti aviwe hi swiphemu swimbirhi: U nga ha tirha u ri karhi u endza ematikweni kumbe u hunguta matirhiselo ya wena ya mali. Xihloko lexi xi vulavula hi mhaka leyi nga hundza.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Lava nga riki ni mhaka ni nkarhi ni leswaku ndhawu yi njhani kambe va lava ku tirhisa mali yitsongo a va vone bajeti yo endza.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Xitsundzuxo lexi xi vula leswaku vaendzi a va yivi, a va ngheni laha va nga pfumeleriwangiki,ni ku xavisa swilo leswi yirisiweke, ku kombela kumbe ku dyelela vanhu van’wana leswaku va vuyeriwa.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Tindhawu to kambela ta vapfhumba i ndhawu yo sungula leyi u ya ka eka yona loko u huma eka xihahampfhuka, exikepeni kumbe eka xo famba xin’wana ni rin’wana.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Tindhawu tinwana ta switimela leswi hundzaka mindzilikano ku kamberiwa swi ri karhi swi famba, u fanele u va u ri na pasi ra vutitivisi leri tirhaka loko u khandziya switimela leswi.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Eka switimela leswi u nga tlelaka eka swona, mufambisi a nga ha teka tipasi leswaku mi nga kavanyetiwi loko mi etlele.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Vutsarisi i nchumu lowu lavekaka loko u fanele u endla xikombelo xa visa. Ematikweni man’wana, u fanele u tsarisa leswaku u kona ni adirese ya laha u tshamaka kona eka valawuri va kwalaho.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Leswi swi nga lava ku tata fomo emaphoriseni ya kwalaho kumbe u endzela etihofisini ta vapfhumba.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Ematikweni yo tala lawa nga ni milawu yo fana ni leyi, tihodela to tala ti endla swo tsarisa (tiyiseka leswaku wa vutisa).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Eswiyinweni swinwana, lava nga tshamiki endhawini ya vaendzi va boheka ku tsarisa. Vutisa ka ha ri nkarhi hikuva nawu lowu a wu tiveki etindhawini tin’wana.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Vapfapfarhuti va vilela hi mipfapfarhuto ni hi maakelo ya miako. Minpfapfarhuto yo tala yi endliwa hi ndlela leyi nga ta nyanyula vavalangi.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Miako yo tala yi sasekile loko u yi valanga ni loko u yi languta u ri ehenhla ka miako yinwana leyi leheke, kumbe loko u languta hi le fasitereni.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Vupfapfarhuti byi katsa ni ku ni ku hlela ndhawu, vuinjiniyara, swilo swa mavoko swo sasekisa, ku sasekisa endzeni ni le handle.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Leswi madoroba yo tala ma nga le tindhawini ta le kule u nge koti ku kuma tindhawu to titsaki nimadyambu loko u nga yanga eAlbuquerque kumbe eSanta Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Hambiswiritano, tikhasino hinkwato leti xaxametiweke laha, ta xavisa swakunwa, tin’wana ti hungasa vahlaleri hi xikongomelo xo navetisa (ngopfungopfu letikulu leti nga ekusuhi na doroba ra Albuquerque ni ra Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Tivonele: tibara leti kumekaka emadorobeni lamatsongo a ti hlayisekanga eka vaendzi.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Xiphiqo hi leswaku en’walungwini wa New Mexico vanhu vo tala va chayela va dakwile, naswona va rhandza ku fambela etibarheni.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Swifaniso leswi nga riki enawini leswi mpfampfarhutiweke emakhumbini swi vitaniwa girafiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Hambileswi swi nga faniki na leswi endliwaka masiku lawa kambe vanhu vo tala va ehleketa leswaku swi endliwe hi vantshwa hi xikongomelo xo onha nhundzu.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Hambiswiritano, masiku lawa ku ni vampfampfarhuti va tigirafiti va le nawini, mintlangu yo mpfampfarhuta ni makhumbi lawa va pfumeleriwaka ku mpfampfarhuta eka wona. Mipfampfarhuto leyi ku vulavuriwaka ha yona laha i swifaniso ku nga ri marito lama tsariweke hi pende.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Vaendzi vo tala va swi lava ku dyondza ku hoxa ximhandzana lexi vatliweke lexi vitaniwaka Boomerang.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Loko u lava ku hoxa Boomerang leswaku yi tlhela yi vuya evokweni ra wena tirhisa leyi endliweke kahle.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Kahlekahle tiBoomerang to tala ta le Australia loko u ti hoxa a ta ha vuyi. Loko wa ha dyondza u nga yi hoxi loko ku ri ni moya.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Swakudya leswi vuriwaka Hangi swi swekeriwa ekheleni.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Mikarhi yin’wana khele leri ri cheriwa maribye yo hisa kambe etindhawini tin’wana ku hisa loku ku huma endzeni ka misava.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi i swakudya swa ndhavuko leswi ngo katingiwa kunene swi va swakudya swo lalela.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Etindhawini to tala ta le Rotorua hangi yi swekiwa hi ku hisa loku humaka endzeni ka misava, kasi tin’wana ti kumeka eChristchurch, Wellington ni le kun’wana.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: Khampani ya MetroRail yi na titlilasi timbirhi eka switimela leswi rhwalaka vanhu eCape Town: MetroPlus (nakambe yi vitaniwa Tlilasi Yo Sungula) na Metro (yi vitaniwa Tlilasi Ya Vunharhu).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus ya tsakisa ende a yi talelanga hi vanhu kambe ya durhanyana, hambiswiritano yi chipile loko yi pimanisiwa ni switimela swa le Yuropa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Xitimela xin’wana ni xin’wana xi na matorokisi ya MetroPlus ni ya Metro; Matorokisi ya MetroPlus ma le makumu ka xitimela.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Vuhlayiseki - Tshama u veke mindzhwalo ya wena tihlo, ngopfungopfu loko u endzela matiko man’wana.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: U nga ha tikuma u tirhisiwa ku ngungumerisa swidzidzirisi swa vanhu van’wana u nga swi tivi ivi swi ku nghenisa enghozini.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Leswi swi katsa ku yimisiwa elayinini, hikuva timbyana to nun'hwetela ti nga vitaniwa nkarhi wun’wana ni wun’wana handle ka xitiviso.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Matiko man’wana ma ni milawu ya nsele yo xupula vanhu hambi lava va endlaka milandzu ro sungula; yi katsa malembe ya 10 ejele kumbe rifu.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Tibege leti vonakaka ti nga ri na vini ti yiviwa ngopfu nakambe maphorisa ma ti ehleketelela leswaku ti nga va ti ri na tibomo.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Leswi emakaya u tshamelaka ku hlangana ni switsongwatsongwana, swi nga endleka leswaku se u sawutile.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Kambe etindhawini tin’wana laha u nga ha hlanganaka ni switsongwatsongwana leswintshwa, u le khombyeni ro ngheniwa hi mavabyi.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Nakambe loko ku hisa switsongwatsongwana swi andza hi xihatla naswona swi hanya nkarhi wo leha.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Hi yona mhaka ku ve ni ntungu wa Delhi Belly, Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge ni swin’wana swo fana na swona.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Leswi mukhuhlwana wu nga tala hi xixika, ni swiphiqo swa le ndzeni swi tinyika matimba hi ximumu naswona hambileswi swi nga riki na khombo a swi dyisi vanhu byi rhelela.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Loko u endzela tiko leri ra ha hluvukaka ro sungula kumbe ndhawu leyintshwa, swi nga ku tikela ku twisisa ndhavuko wa kona.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Vanhu vo tala lava toloveleke ku endzela matiko va karhatekile loko va fika eka matiko lama ha hluvukaka, laha a ku laveka leswaku va endla swilo hi ndlela leyi hambaneke.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Loko wa ha ku fika ringeta ku hanya vutomi bya le xilungwini kumbe u ya etihotela ta xiyimo, u dya swakudya leswi u swi tivaka leswaku u ta hatla u tolovela.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: U nga etleli exiponcini kumbe esangwini etindhawni leti nga ni swiharhi leswi u nga swi tiviki.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Loko u ya tlela ehandle, va na ni xiponci xo tlela eka xona lexi nga ta ku sirhelela eka tinyoka, swipamu kumbe swin’wana.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Nimixo n’wana cofi ya xiyimo xa le henhla namadyambu n’wana tiya leyi nga ta ku phyuphyusa.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Loko u vhakela tindhawu ta laha u tshamaka kona u va ni nkarhi wo ringeta tikofi to hambanahambana.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Loko u swi tsakela u nga ringeta ku n’wana tijuzi leti endliweke hi mihandzu yo hambanahambana.
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Kumbexana u ta kuma swakun’wa swo nandziha leswi u nga swi tirhisaka ni mixo loko u tlhela u sungula ku endla swilo leswi a wu swi endla siku ni siku.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Loko u tshama etikweni leri nga ni swakun’wana swo hambanahambana ya na etibarheni kumbe titlabini leti u nga yiki eka tona hi xitalo.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Eka vanhu lava nga tiviki nchumu hi swa vutshunguri rito leri nge tlulelaka ni leri ngetlulela ma vula swilo swo hambana.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Ntungu lowu tlulelaka wu vangiwa hi pathojini, leyi fanaka na vharasi, bakhtheriya, nkurhe kumbe switsotswana leswi lumaka swin’wana.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Ntungu wo ku tlulela wu nghena loko hi tshenelelana ni munhu loyi a vabyaka.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Mifumo ya matiko yo tala yi lava leswaku vanhu lava endzaka, kumbe lava endzelaka matiko man’wana va tlhava nsawutiso wa mavabyi yo hambanahambana.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Leswi swi ya hi leswaku munhu u endzela etikweni rihi kumbe u kunguhata ku endza kwini.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Mhaka leyi tsakisaka ngopfu hi Charlotte, North Carolina, hi leswaku yi na swilo swo tala swa xiyimo xa le henhla xa mindyangu.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Vanhu va le tindhawini tin’wana hakanyingi va tshaha ku tshamiseka-ka ndyangu tanihi xona xivangelo nkulu xo ya tshama kwalaho, naswona vayeni va tala ku tiphina eka doroba loko va famba na vana endhawini yoleyo.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Eka malembe ya 20 lama hundzeke, nhlayo ya tindhawu leti tsakisaka-vana ti engetelane ngopfu swinene eUptown Charlotte.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Mathekisi a ya tali ku tirhisiwa hi mindyangu eCharlotte, kambe i ya nkoka eka swiyimo swin’wana.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Ku na ntsengo lowu engetelekeke loko vanhu va famba va ri 2, hikwalaho fambelo leri ri nga dura ku swi nga fanelangi.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctica i ndhawu yo titimela swinene Emisaveni, naswona yi rhendzelekele South Pole.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Maendzo ya vapfhumba ma durha, ma lava munhu a va a tiyerile emirini, naswona ma nga endliwa ntsena hi ximumu hi Hukuri-Nyenyana, naswona ma endleriwa ntsena eka Nhlonhle, Swihlala na Lwandle ra Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Vatirhi va magidi ma nga ri mangani va tshama kona hi ximumu eka tindhawu ta kwalomu ka makume-mune-nhungu etindhawini teto; nhlayo leyitsongo yi tshama hi xixika.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Antarctica ya le ndzeni i ndhawu leyi nga tshamiki munhu leyi funengetiweke hi gwitsi mpfhuka wa 2-3 wa tikhilomitara.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Mapfhumba yo hlawuleka ya le moyeni ya minkarhi yo karhi ya endliwa endzeni ka tiko, ka vakhandziyi va tintshava kumbe ku fikelela Pole, laha ku nga ni ndhawu leyikulu yo gova eka yona.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (kumbe Highway) yi le ka 1600 km ku suka eMcMurdo Station eRoss Sea kuya eka Pole.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Gamboko ya yona leyi manyaneke yi thlela yi pandzeka leyi hoxiweke mijeko. Ku fambiwa ntsena hi ti teretere leti endliweke hi ndlela yo hlawuleka, ti na swilo swa ku rhwala ndzhwalo wa mafurha na mpahla.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Leti a ti olovi ngopfu hikwalaho ndlela yi fanele yi rhendzeleka hi Tintshava Ta Transantarctic leswaku ku fikiwa erivaleni leri tlakukeke.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Xivangelo nkulu xa tingozi hi xixika i mapatu lama rhetaka, ti phayivimente (tindlela ta le tlhelo) na magoza.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Xo sungula, u fanele u va na tintanghu leti nga na solo leyi faneleke. Minkarhi yo tala tintanghu ta ximumu ta rhetisa eka gwitsi na gamboko, na tibutsu tin’wana ta xixika a ti enelanga.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Phateni yi fanele yi enta hilaha ku ringaneke, 5 mm (1/5 inch) kumbe ku hundza, naswona lapi ri fanele ri olova eka tindhawu to titimela.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Tibutsu tin’wana ti khavisiwe hi nsimbi naswona ku ni nsimbi leyi engeteleriweke leswaku ti nga rheti eka tindhawu leti rhetisaka, leti faneleke tintanghu to tala ni tibutsu, ti endleriwe xirhendze kumbe xirhendze na solo.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Ti hili ti fanele ti va tale ehansi no anama. Sava, giravhele kumbe munyu (khalisiyamu tlilorayidi) swi tala ku hangalasiwa emapatwini leswaku ku antwisiwa ku khomelela.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Maribye ya gamboko leyi waka ya tolovelekile; ndhawu leyi kwezaka yi kota ku khoma gamboko ya mpimo wo karhi, kutani leyi yin’wani yi ta wa tanihi maribye ya gamboko.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Xiphiqo hi leswaku gamboko ya khomelela, hikwalaho yi fanele yi sunguriwa laswaku yi vohla, naswona loko gamboko yin’wana yi sungula ku vohla yi nga pfuna na leyin’wana leswaku yi vohla.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Nkarhi wun’wana lexi sungulaka ku vohlisa gamboko i dyambu loko ri yi kufumeta, nkarhi wun’wana ku wa ka gamboko, nkarhi wun’wana swiendlakalo swin’wana swa ntumbuluko, minkarhi yo tala i munhu.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Xihuhuri I moya wa pureja ya le hansi lowu rhendzelekaka, lowu kokaka moya lowu nga ekusuhi wu nghena wu tlhela wu huma hi le henhla.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Ti endla moya lowukulu (nkarhi wun’wana 100-200 ti mayile/awara) naswona xi nga tlakula swilo swo tika swiya emoyeni, xihuhuri xi swi tlakula loko xi ri karhi xi famba.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Loko swi sungula swi sungula tanihi tifanele leti ehlaka emapapeni, naswona ku va “xihuhuri” loko xi khumba misava.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Vanyiketi va ti VPN (virtual private network) ya munhu yi wexe hi yona ndlela ya kahle ya ku hlula swiphiqo swa swipimelo swa politiki swinwe na ku pfala tiwebhusayithi ta mabindzu eka vanhu va ku yiva.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: I tikulu eka ti purokizi ta web hi swivangelo swo hlaya: Ti fambisa hinkwako ku kwentlembana ka intanethe, ku nga ri http ntsena.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Ku toloveleke leswaku ti va na intanethe leyi tirhaka kahle na vukorhokeri lebyi antswaka. Vuxokoxoko byi tumbetiwe naswona sweswo swiendla ku tika ku ti kuma.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Tikhampani ta mediya ta hemba hi xikongomelo xa leswi, ti vula leswaku leswi swi endliwela ku “siva piracy”.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Entiyisweni, tikhowudi ta ndhawu abyi khumbi ni katsonga ku kopiwa loku ku nga riki nawini; ku kopa ka diski ka ntsongo ni kantsongo ku ta tlanga kahle eka divayisi yin’wana ni yin’wana leyi pfumalaka diski ya ntiyiso.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Xikongomelo xa ntiyiso i ku nyika tikhamphani teto vulawuri lebyi engetelekeke eka timakete teto; hi ku endla ntsena mali leyi engeteleleke.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Tanihi leswi ku foyiniwaka hi Inthaneti, a ku laveki leswaku u tirhisa foyini ya khamphani leyi kumekaka eka ndhawu leyi u tshamaka eka yona kumbe u yi vhakelaka.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Naswona a ku laveki leswaku u kuma nomboro ya ndhawu leyi u tshamaka eka yona; u nga kuma sethalayiti ya Inthanete emakhwatini ya Tihuku, eAlaska naswona u hlawula nomboro leyi kombisaka leswaku u le Arizona leyi hisaka.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Minkarhi yo tala, u fanele u xava nomboro leyi tirhisiwaka emisaveni hinkwayo leyi pfumelaka tifoyini ta PSTN ti ku foyinela. Laha tinomboro ti humaka kona ti endla ku hambana eka vanhu lava va ku foyinelaka.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Tiapp ta ku hundzuluxela tsalwa – hi switirhisiwa leswi kotaka ku hundzuluxela tilayini hinkwato ta tsalwa ku sukela eka ririmi rin’wana ku ya eka rin’wana.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Swin’wana swa switirhisiwa eka kholamu leyi swi nga hundzuluxela marito lama nga le ka tindzimi tin’wana eka xikombo kumbe swilo swin’wana loko mutirhisi a komba foyini ya manguva lama eka swilo sweswo.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Tinjini ta ku hundzuluxela ti hluvuke ngopfu, naswona ku toloveleke leswaku ti hundzulxa kahle (swa kala ku kuma vuhundzuluxeri lebyi hoxeke), kambe u fanele u tivonela, tanihi leswi swi nga hundzuluxaka hi ndlela leyi hoxeke.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Yin’wana ya tiapp leti dumeke eka muxaka lowu i Google Translate, leyi yi ku pfumelelaka leswaku u hundzuluxeriwa hambiloko u nga nghenanga eka inthanete endzhaku ka ku dawunilowda data ya ririmi leri u ri lavaka.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Ku tirhisa tiapp leti pfumelaka GPS eka foyini ya wena ya manguva lama swi nga ku olovela ngopfu naswona yi nga va ndlela ya ku olova loko u lavisisa u ri karhi u ri ehandle ka tiko ra wena.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Yi nga hlayisa mali ya wena ematshan’wini ya mimepe leyintshwa ya ti GPS,kumbe divayisi leyi yi tiyimeleke ya GPS kumbe ku renta yin’we ya tikhamphani leti rentisa hi timovha.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Loko u nga ri na data eka foyinini ya wena kumbe loko inthanete yi nga tirhi kahle, ku tirha ka yona ku nga va na swipimelo kumbe yi nga tirhi.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Xitolo xin’wana ni xin’wana xi tele hi makhadi ya tifoyini lama hakeleriwaka lama nga tirhisiwaka eka ti foyini leti u hakelaka kumbe ti foyini tale kaya.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Hambiloko makhadi yo tala ma ri kahle hi ku foyina kun’wana ni kun’wana, man’wana makahle ngopfu hi eka ntsengo wa ku foyina lowu nga kahle loko u foyinela matiko man’wana.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Vukorhokeri lebyi byi tala ku kumeka hi ku foyinela nomboro ya mahala leyi yi nga foyineriwaka eka tifoyini to tala handle ka ku hakela.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Milawu leyi fambisanaka ni ku tekiwa ka swinepe ya tirha na loko ku tekiwa vhidiyo, naswona yi tirha hi ndlela leyi engeteleleke.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Loko ku tekiwa ka swinepe swi nga pfumeleriwi,sweswo swi vula leswaku u nga ehleketi ni ku ehleketa hi ku teka vhidiyo eka ndhawu yo leyo.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Loko u tirhisa drone, languta ka ha ri nkarhi leswaku i yini leswi u pfumeleriweke ku swifilima naswona ku laveka mpfumelelo kumbe layisense ya njhani.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Ku hahisa drone kusuhi na xitixi xa swihaha mpfhuka kumbe eka ntshungu ku tshama ku vonelo ro biha, hambiloko ku pfumeriwa hi nawu eka ndhawu ya wena.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Namutlha swa kala ku buka xihaha mpfhuka eka khamphani ya xona u nga rhanganga hi ku lavisisa na ku pimanisa mintsengo ya tikhamphani.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Minkarhi yinwana xihaha mpfuka lexi fanaka xi nga va na mintsengo leyi hambeneke eka loko u hlanganise hinkwayo naswona swa pfuna ku pimanisa ntsengo lowu humaka loko u lavisisa na ku languta eka webusayiti ya khamphani ya xihaha mpfhuka u nga si buka.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Hambiloko ku nga ta laveka vhisa ku vhakela matiko yo karhi swa xinkadyana tanihi mupfhumba kumbe munhu wa mabindzu, ku ya eka matiko yo tano tanihi mudyondzi ku lava nkarhi wo leha ku ri na kuya tanihi mupfhumba ntsena.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Hi ntolovelo, ku tshama eka tiko rin’wana nkarhi wo leha ku ta lava u kuma vhisa ka ha ri emahlweni.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Ku toloveleke leswaku tivhisa ta vadyondzi ti va na swilaveko swo hambana na milawu leyi hambaneke eka tivhisa ta vapfhumba kumbe vanhu va mabindzu.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Eka matiko yo tala, u ta lava papila ra xikolo lexi u nga tsakela ku dyondza eka xona, na vumbhoni bya mali leyi yi nga ta ku hlayisa eka lembe ro sungula ra tidyondzo ta wena.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Vutisa eka xikolo, na hofisi ya swa vufambi bya tiko leri u yaka ku ya dyondza eka rona leswaku u kuma vuxokoxoko lebyi engetelekeke.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Handle ka loko u ri mudipulomati, ku tirha e tikweni rimbe swi vula leswaku u fanele u hakela xibalo xa muholo eka tiko leri u nga eka rona.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Xibalo xa muholo xi hambanile eka matiko yo hambana, naswona ti rheyiti na tlawa wa xibalo swi hambanile ku suka eka tiko kuya eka rin’wana.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Eka matiko man’wana ya federali, yo fana na United Stated na Khanada, xibalo xa muholo xi tekiwa eka ntlawa wa federali ni wa laha u tshamaka kona, hikwalaho ti rheyiti ti na ntlawa swi nga hambana ku suka eka ndhawu kuya eka ndhawu yin’wana.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Hambileswi loko u fika eka ndhawu ya ka n’wina va nga kambisisiki swa vupfhumba bya wena kumbe ku lavisisa hi swa xinawu, ku lawula swa nhavuko ku nga ha tika.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Tiyiseka leswaku wa swi tiva leswi u pfumeleriweke ku ngena naswona kumbe u nga pfuleleriwangi hi xinawu.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Ndlela yo olova yo sungula bindzu ro tsala hi swa vufambi i ku antswisa vuswikoti bya wena eka webusayiti ya bulogo leyi kumekaka ya swa vufambi.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Endzhaku ka loko u kota matsalelo ni ku lunghisa matsalelo eka webusayiti, endzhaku, u nga endla ya wena webusayiti.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Ku tinyikela hi ku tirhandzela loko u ri karhi u famba i ndlela leyinene yo tisa ku cinca kambe a kova ku nyika ntsena.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Ku tshama ni ku tinyiketela hi ku swi rhandza eka tiko rin’wana i ndlela leyinene yo tiva ndhavuko wa vanhu van’wana, u hlangana ni vanhu van’wana, u dyondza hi wena n’wini, u vona mavonelo man’wana naswona u kuma vuswikoti lebyintswha.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Swi nga va mhaka ya kahle loko u anamisa bajeti ya wena leswaku u tshama nkarhi wo leha hikuva mintirho yo tala yo tirhandzela hi va na byetlelo naswona a hi yingani leyi nyikaka muholo nyana wutsongo.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Va Viking va tirhise tindlela ta le matini ta Rhaxiya leswaku va fika eLwandle Ra Ntima na Lwandle Ra Caspian. Swiyenge swin’wana swa tindlela leti swa ha tirhisiwa. Languta loko swi koteka leswaku u kuma mpfumelelo wo hlawuleka, lowu swi nga ha tikakia leswaku u wu kuma.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Lwandle Ro Basa–Balanti Canal yi hlanganisa Arctic Ocean na Lwandle Ra Baltic, ri hundza hi Tiva Ra Onega, Tiva Ra Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, ko tala ngopfu hi minkova na mativa.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Tiva Ra Onega na rona ri hlangane na Volga, hikwalaho loko u suka eLwandle Ra Caspian u hundza hi le Rhaxiya swa ha koteka.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Tiyiseka leswaku loko u fika ematini swilo hinkwaswo swi ta va erivaleni. U ta kuna van’wana lava hayikaka swikepe naswona va ta avelana vuxokoxoko bya vona na wena.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Kahlekahle u ta va u veka switiviso hi mpfuno wa wena, u lunghisa ndhawu yo layicha no chicha swikepe eka yona, u tshinelela vanhu u basisa swikepe swa vona,u ringeta ku tihlanganisa ni vachayeri va swikepe ebhareni, sweswo sweswo.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Ringeta ku vula vula ni vanhu vo tala hilaha u nga kotaka hakona. Endzaku ka nkarhi nyana vanhu hikwavo va ta ku tiva naswona va ta ku byela leswaku hi xihi xikepe lexi lavaka munhu.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: U fanele u hlawula xihaha mpfhuka lexi u fambaka hi xona nkarhi hinkwawo hi vukheta eka ntlawa wa swona.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Hambileswi u nga ha ehleketaka leswaku i swa ntumbuluko ku hlawula xihaha mpfuka lexi u xi tirhisaka ko tala, u fanele u lemuka leswaku malunghelo lama nyikiwaka ya hambana eka minkarhi yo tala naswona switici swo karhi swi nga hanana hi ndlela yo hambana ehansi ka swihaha mpfuka leswi nga eka ntlawa lowu fanaka.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Swihaha mpfuka swo fana na Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines swi andzise vukorhokeri bya swona swinene kuya eAfrika, naswona swi hlanganisa madoroba wo tala lamakulu eAfrika hi ntsengo wa le hansi eka ya swihaha mpfhuka swa le Yuropa.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines yi ya eka tindhawu ta 39 eka matiko ya 30 ya Afrika ku suka hi 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Loko u ri ni nkarhi lowu ngeteleleke wo famba, langutisa loko mali hinkwayo leyi u nga ta yi hakela kuya eAfrika yi pimanisiwe ni ya misava-hikwayo.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: U nga rivali ku katsa mali leyi engetelekeke ya tivhisa leti ngetelekeke, swibalo swo suka, swifambo leswi nga ta ku yisa erivaleni ra swihaha mpfhuka, sweswo sweswo. Eka tindhawu hinkwato leti nga handle ka Afrika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Loko u lava ku famba hi xihaha mpfuka misava hikwayo eDzongeni Wa Misava hinkwako, ku hlawula eka xihaha mpfhuka na tindhawu leti u yaka eka tona a swi talanga hikwalaho ko pfumaleka ka mapatu ya le lwandle.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: A ku na ntlawa wa swihaha mpfhuka lowu hlanganisaka tindlela tinharhu to tsemakanya lwandle eDzongeni Wa Misava (naswona SkyTeam a yi hlanganisi na yin’we ndlela yo tsemakanya lwandle).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Hambiswiritano, Star Alliance yi hlanganisa hinkwato handle ka vuxeni bya South Pacific ku suka eSantiago de Chile kuya eTahiti, leyi nga xihaha mpfhuka xa LATAM lexi hlanganisaka misava hinkwayo
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Xihaha mpfhuka lexi a xi wexe loko u lava ku hundza eSouth Pacific ns vupela dyambu bya Amerika Dyonga. (vona laha hansi)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Hi 1994, ndhawu leyi tshaka hi Vaarmeniya ya Nagorno-Karabakh eAzerbaijan yi sungule nyimpi ku lwisana na Vaazeri
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Hi ku seketeriwa hi Armeniya, rhiphabuliki leyintswha yi sunguriwile. Hambiswiritano, a ku na tiko leri yimeke - hambi ku ri Armeniya - leri ri tivaka ximfumo.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Ku vula vurisana ka xidipulomati ku yela emalweni ku onha vuxaka exikarhi ka Armeniya na Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Xifundza Xa Canal (Dutch: Grachtengordel) I xifundza lexi dumeke xa lembe xidzana ra vu 17 leri rhendzeleke Binnenstad ya le Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Xifundza hinkwaxo xi endliwe ndhawu ya UNESCO World Heritage Site hikwalaho ka ndhavuko ya xona lowu hambaneke na matimu, na miako ya xona ya vitana swinene eka miako ya tiko hinkwaro.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, leswi vulaka Tindhawu Ta Ntlhanu, yi endliwa hi matiko xikaya ya ntlhanu lama nge ekusuhi na lwandle ku nga Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso lama kumekaka eLiguria ya le Itali.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Ti xaxametiwile eka UNESCO World Heritage List.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Eka malembe xidzana lama hundzeke, vanhu va tirhise vukheta ku endla mapatu eka tindhawu to kwaza, kuya eka switshunga swale lwandle.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Swin’wana leswi endlaka yi tsakisa i ku kayivela ka nhluvukiso wa swa mabindzu. Tindlela, switimela na mabyatso swi hlanganisa matiko xikaya lama, naswona timovha a ti koti ku fikelela ku suka etindhawini tin’wana.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Xifurwa xo hambana hambana lexi vulavuriwaka eBeligium na Switzerland swi hambana kantsongo ni Xifurwa lexi vulavuriwaka eFurwa, hambiloko xi twisiseka ku fana.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Xifurwa lexi vulavuriwaka eBelgium na Switzerland ku na ku hambana lokuntsoongo na loku ku nga tolovelekangiki ngopfu ngopfu eka tinomborho ku na Xifurwa lexi vulavuriwaka eFurwa, naswona ndlela ya ku vitana mavito man’wana yi hambanile ka ntsongo.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Hambiswiritano, vanhu hinkwavo va le Belgium na le Switzerland lava vulavulaka Xifurwa, va nga va vadyondze Xifurwa xo olova exikolweni, kutani va nga ku tswisisa hambiloko u tirhisa ndlela ya ku hlaya tinomborho hi Xifurwa lexi oloveke.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Eka tindhawu to tala ta misava, ku tlakusa voko i ndlela ya ku kombisa vunghana, leyi kombisaka “ku xeweta.”
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Kambe, eMalaysia, ngopfu ngopfu emalayinini ya le Malays, yi vula leswaku “tanani” yi fana na ritiho ra ku komba loko u ri pfula u tlhela u ri pfala, leswi swi endliwa eka matiko man’wana ya le Vupela dyambu, naswona yi fanele yi tirhiseriwa sweswo ntsena.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Hi ndlela leyi fanaka, mufambi wa le Britain loko a ri Spaniya a nga ehleketa leswaku wa vitaniwa loko munhu a n’wi yimisela voko hi ndlela yo n’wi lela, loko voko ri langute munhu loyi a ri leriwaka, (ematshanwini ya ku languta munhu loyi a leriwaka).
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Tindzimi to pfuneta kumbe leti endliweke i tindzimi leti endleriweke leswaku vanhu lava swi va tikelaka ku twisisana hi ririmi va kota ku twisisana.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Ti hambanile eka tindzimi leti tekiwaka tanihi leti tolovekeke leti nga endliwaka kumbe i tindzimi leti ti dumaka hi xivangelo xin’we kumbe swin’wana leswi tirhiseriwaka ku vulavula ka vanhu lava va nga tirhisiki ririmi rin’we.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Eka siku leri hisaka, vafambi va nga vona timiraji leti vonakaka onge i mati (kumbe swilo swin’wana).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Leswi swi nga ni khombo loko mufambi a sukela timaraji, a tlanga hi matimba ya nkoka na mati lama saleke.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Na tindhawu ta le managa leti hisaka ngopfu ti nga titimela ngopfu na vusiku. U nga twa xirhami swinene loko u nga mbalangi swa ku kupfumela.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Ngopfu ngopfu eka ximumu, ku ta laveka u tivonela eka tinsuna loko u teke xiboho xa ku khandziya ntshava eka makhwati lama ku tolovelekeke hi mpfula.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Hambiloko u rheyila eka makhwati lama ku tolovelekeke hi mpfula, tisekende tingari tingani u pfule mavanti loko wa ha nghena emovheni ti ringanile leswaku tinsuna ti nghena na wena.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Mkhuhlwana wa swinyenyani, kumbe lowu tiviwaka tanihi avian influenza hi xinawu, wu nga nghena eka swinyenyani ni le ka swiharhi leswi mamisaka.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Eka vanhu ku vikiwe tikheyisi leti nga fikiki eka gidi, kambe tin’wana ta tona ta dlaya.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Swo tala a swi katsa vanhu lava tirhaka hi tihuku, kambe na khombo ri nga va kona eka vanhu lava rindzaka swinyenyani.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: ENorway ku toloveleke xiganga xa tifjord na minkova leyi yi ku yisaka eka ndhawu leyi tlakukeke, leyi fanaka na rivala.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Mavala lama tlakukeke lama tolovelekeke ku vuriwa tanihi "vidde" leswi vulaka ndawu leyi anameke, yi pfulekeke leyi yi nga na minsinya,le yi nga bihiwangiki.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: ERogaland na eAgder ti tiviwa tanihi "hei" leyi vulaka misava leyi yi nga riki na misinya leyi toloveleke ku funengetiwa hi heathera ehenhla.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Minkova ya gwitsi a yi yimanga eka ndhawu yin’we, kambe yi khuluka etintshaveni. Leswi swi ta vangela ku pandzeka, ku pfuleka swinene ka ndhawu leyi pandzekeke, leyi yi tumbetiwaka hi mabuloho ya gamboko.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Makhumbi na ku fuleriwa ka mabakwa lama nga na gwitsi ma nga wa naswona ku pandzeka ku nga pfaleka.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Emahetelelweni ya minkova leyi yi nga na gwitsi, tiblokho leti kulu ta tshoveka, ta wa naswona swi nga endleka leswaku swi nga tlula kumbe rhendzeleka kule na le mahetelelweni.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Nkarhi wa vumpfhumba eka xitshunga yi tolovele ku tlakuka hi nkarhi wa ximumu le Indiya.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Kambe, ku na swilo swo saseka swo hambana leswi vaka kona hi xixika, swin’we na tindhawu to tala ta xitshunga leti kumaka gamboko leyi yi nga talangiki ngopfu na leyi yi endlaka ku va na ntlangu wa ku rheta eka gamboko.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Ku lo sala tikhampani ta swihaha mpfhuka tingari tingani leti nga na mali ya ku loveriwa, leyi yi endlaka ku hungutiwa katsongo eka mali leyi u fanele u yi hakela loko u famba u ya nkosini hi timinete ta makumu.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Swihaha mpfhuka leswi nyiketaka leswi swi katsa Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa eka swihaha mpfhuka leswi humaka eU.S. kumbe Khanada na WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Eka swiyimo hikwaswo, u fanele u buka hi foyini eka khampani ya swihaha mpfhuka.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
